    private fun requestNotificationPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS), 101)
            }
        }
    }

    
    private fun sendToApi(prompt: String) {
        updateStatus("Calling API...")
        ApiClient.sendPrompt(
            this,
            etApiKey.text.toString().trim(),
            prompt,
            onResponse = { response ->
                runOnUiThread {
                    updateStatus("")
                    log("📥 API Response received.\n", Color.GREEN)
                    processAiResponse(response)
                }
            },
            onError = { error ->
                runOnUiThread {
                    updateStatus("")
                    log("❌ API Error: $error\n", Color.RED)
                    stopAgent()
                }
            }
        )
    }

    private fun stopAgent() {
        if (isRunning) {
            isRunning = false
            handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
            val session = getAgentSession()
            if (session != null) session.write("\u0003")
            log("\n🛑 Agent stopped by user.", Color.RED)
            updateStatus("")
            updateProgress(0)
            toggleButtons(running = false)
            stopService(Intent(this, AgentForegroundService::class.java))
        }
    }

    private fun toggleButtons(running: Boolean) {
        runOnUiThread {
            if (running) {
                btnStart.isEnabled = false; btnStop.visibility = View.VISIBLE; etPrompt.isEnabled = false
            } else {
                btnStart.isEnabled = true; btnStop.visibility = View.GONE; etPrompt.isEnabled = true
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateDataUsage() {
        val currentRx = TrafficStats.getUidRxBytes(Process.myUid())
        val currentTx = TrafficStats.getUidTxBytes(Process.myUid())
        if (currentRx != TrafficStats.UNSUPPORTED.toLong() && currentTx != TrafficStats.UNSUPPORTED.toLong()) {
            val deltaRx = currentRx - startRx
            val deltaTx = currentTx - startTx
            val totalMB = (deltaRx + deltaTx) / (1024.0 * 1024.0)
            runOnUiThread {
                tvDataUsage.text = String.format("Data used: %.2f MB", totalMB)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun ensureTerminalSession() {
        val existing = agentSession?.takeIf { it.isRunning }
            ?: TerminalManager.sessions.lastOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isRunning }
        if (existing != null) {
            agentSession = existing
            Logger.i("Agent", "Reusing session pid=" + existing.getPid())
            return
        }
        (application as LiteApp).writeDnsConfig()
        val session = SessionFactory.createSession(this, 80, 24)
        if (session != null) {
            TerminalManager.addSession(session)
            agentSession = session
            Logger.i("Agent", "Created new session pid=" + session.getPid())
        } else {
            Logger.e("Agent", "Failed to create terminal session")
            log("ERROR: Failed to create terminal session (Alpine not installed?)", Color.RED)
        }
    }

    private fun getAgentSession(): TerminalSession? {
        return agentSession?.takeIf { it.isRunning }
            ?: TerminalManager.sessions.lastOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isRunning }
    }

    private fun setupWebView() {
        // WebView is completely disabled. DeepSeek is commented out.
        Logger.i("Agent", "WebView setup skipped (API mode only)")
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        webView.onResume()

    }

    private fun log(msg: String, color: Int = Color.WHITE) {
        runOnUiThread {
            val start = logBuilder.length
            logBuilder.append(msg).append("\n")
            logBuilder.setSpan(ForegroundColorSpan(color), start, logBuilder.length, 0)
            if (logBuilder.length > 50000) logBuilder.delete(0, 20000)
            tvLog.text = logBuilder
            try {
                val sv = tvLog.parent as? ScrollView
                sv?.post { sv.fullScroll(View.FOCUS_DOWN) }
            } catch (e: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    private fun updateStatus(status: String) {
        if (status == lastStatusLine) return
        lastStatusLine = status
        runOnUiThread {
            if (status.isEmpty()) tvStatus.visibility = View.GONE
            else {
                tvStatus.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                tvStatus.text = "⏳ $status"
                tvStatus.setTextColor(if (status.contains("[Local Cache]")) Color.parseColor("#4CAF50") else Color.parseColor("#2196F3"))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateProgress(percent: Int) {
        runOnUiThread {
            layoutProgress.visibility = View.VISIBLE
            pbTaskProgress.progress = percent
            tvProgressPercent.text = "$percent%"
            tvProgressPercent.setTextColor(if (percent == 100) Color.parseColor("#4CAF50") else Color.parseColor("#2196F3"))
        }
    }

    private fun saveMessageToChat(role: String, content: String) {
        currentChatMessages.add(ChatMessage(role, content))
        currentChatFolder?.let { ChatManager.saveChatHistory(it, currentChatMessages) }
    }

    private fun buildMemoryContext(): String {
        if (recentSteps.isEmpty() && aiNotes.isEmpty() && originalTask.isEmpty()) return ""
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("\n[MEMORY - PREVIOUS PROGRESS]\n")
        if (originalTask.isNotEmpty()) sb.append("Original Task: $originalTask\n\n")
        if (aiNotes.isNotEmpty()) {
            sb.append("[Key Notes you learned earlier]:\n")
            aiNotes.takeLast(10).forEach { sb.append("- $it\n") }
            sb.append("\n")
        }
        if (recentSteps.isNotEmpty()) {
            sb.append("[Recent Steps Summary]:\n")
            recentSteps.takeLast(5).forEachIndexed { i, (cmd, out) ->
                sb.append("${i + 1}. Command: ${cmd.take(200).replace('\n', ' ')}\n")
                sb.append("   Output: ${out.take(300).replace('\n', ' ')}\n")
            }
            sb.append("\n")
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    private fun saveMemoryToFile() {
        try {
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            sb.append("TASK: $originalTask\n")
            aiNotes.forEach { sb.append("NOTE: $it\n") }
            recentSteps.forEach { (cmd, out) ->
                sb.append("STEP: ${cmd.replace('\n', ' ').take(500)}\n")
                sb.append("OUTPUT: ${out.replace('\n', ' ').take(1000)}\n")
            }
            agentMemoryFile.writeText(sb.toString())
        } catch (e: Exception) { Logger.e("Agent", "saveMemory error", e) }
    }

    private fun extractAiNotes(text: String) {
        try {
            val regex = Regex("\\[NOTE:\\s*([^\\]]+)\\]")
            regex.findAll(text).forEach { match ->
                val note = match.groupValues[1].trim()
                if (note.isNotEmpty() && !aiNotes.contains(note)) {
                    aiNotes.add(note)
                    if (aiNotes.size > 20) aiNotes.removeAt(0)
                    Logger.i("Agent", "AI note saved: $note")
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun startAgent(prompt: String) {
        isRunning = true
        toggleButtons(running = true)
        logBuilder.clear()
        updateStatus("")
        updateProgress(0)

        startRx = TrafficStats.getUidRxBytes(Process.myUid())
        startTx = TrafficStats.getUidTxBytes(Process.myUid())
        if (startRx == TrafficStats.UNSUPPORTED.toLong()) startRx = 0L
        if (startTx == TrafficStats.UNSUPPORTED.toLong()) startTx = 0L
        updateDataUsage()

        startForegroundService(Intent(this, AgentForegroundService::class.java))

        originalTask = prompt
        recentSteps.clear()
        aiNotes.clear()
        lastExecutedCommand = ""
        agentMemoryFile.delete()

        log("🤖 Starting Agent with task: $prompt\n", Color.CYAN)
        currentChatFolder = ChatManager.createNewChat(prompt)
        currentChatMessages.clear()
        saveMessageToChat("user", prompt)
        ensureTerminalSession()

        val apiKey = etApiKey.text.toString().trim()
        val apiModel = etApiModel.text.toString().trim()
        
        if (apiKey.isEmpty()) {
            log("❌ API key is missing! Please enter it above.\n", Color.RED)
            stopAgent()
            return
        }

        val systemPrompt = """
            [INSTRUCTIONS]
            You are an expert Alpine Linux terminal bot. Your ONLY job is to output a single bash command wrapped in ```bash and ``` blocks.
            Do NOT explain anything. Do NOT use markdown outside the code block.
            You are running as root.
            [TASK]
            $prompt
        """.trimIndent()

        // فراخوانی مستقیم API
        sendToApi(systemPrompt)
        handler.postDelayed({ checkAiResponse() }, 2000)
    }

    private fun sendToAI(text: String) {
        // Deprecated. Handled by sendToApi now.
    }

    private var aiCheckAttempts = 0
    private var lastAiText = ""

    private fun checkAiResponse() {
        // Deprecated.
    }

    private fun processAiResponse(command: String) {
        log("\n💻 Running Command:\n$command\n", Color.parseColor("#FF9800"))
        lastExecutedCommand = command

        val session = getAgentSession()
        if (session != null) {
            val scriptFile = File(filesDir, "home/run_agent.sh")
            scriptFile.writeText(command.replace("\r", "").trim() + "\n")
            val startMarker = "___AGENT_START___"
            val endMarker = "___AGENT_END___"
            session.write("echo \"$startMarker\"; sh /root/run_agent.sh < /dev/null; echo \"$endMarker\"\r")
            log("⏳ Executing...", Color.GRAY)
            updateStatus("Starting execution...")
            handler.postDelayed({ readTerminalOutput(startMarker, endMarker, 0) }, 1000)
        } else {
            log("❌ Error: No terminal session.", Color.RED)
            stopAgent()
        }
    }

    private fun readTerminalOutput(startMarker: String, endMarker: String, attempts: Int) {
        if (!isRunning) return
        if (attempts > 600) {
            log("❌ Error: Command execution timed out.", Color.RED)
            updateStatus(""); stopAgent(); return
        }
        val session = getAgentSession()
        if (session == null) {
            handler.postDelayed({ readTerminalOutput(startMarker, endMarker, attempts + 1) }, 500); return
        }
        thread {
            val screenText = session.emulator?.screen?.getTranscriptText() ?: ""
            if (screenText.contains(endMarker)) {
                val startIndex = screenText.lastIndexOf(startMarker)
                val endIndex = screenText.lastIndexOf(endMarker)
                if (startIndex != -1 && endIndex != -1 && endIndex > startIndex) {
                    val rawOutput = screenText.substring(startIndex + startMarker.length, endIndex)
                    val cleanOutput = rawOutput.replace(Regex("\u001B\\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]"), "")
                        .lines().filterNot { it.contains("sh /root/run_agent.sh") || it.contains("echo \"___AGENT") }
                        .joinToString("\n").trim()
                    var finalOutput = if (cleanOutput.isEmpty()) "Command executed successfully (no output)." else cleanOutput
                    if (finalOutput.length > 5000) finalOutput = finalOutput.take(5000) + "\n... (output truncated)"

                    if (lastExecutedCommand.isNotEmpty()) {
                        recentSteps.add(lastExecutedCommand to finalOutput)
                        if (recentSteps.size > 8) recentSteps.removeAt(0)
                        saveMemoryToFile()
                    }

                    runOnUiThread {
                        if (!isRunning) return@runOnUiThread
                        updateStatus("")
                        log("\n📄 Output:\n$finalOutput\n", Color.YELLOW)
                        saveMessageToChat("terminal_output", finalOutput)

                        val nextPrompt = buildMemoryContext() +
                            "\n[COMMAND OUTPUT TO ANALYZE]\n$finalOutput\n\nWhat is the next command? (Or reply TASK_COMPLETE if done)"
                        
                        log("⏳ Waiting 10s to avoid rate limit...", Color.GRAY)
                        handler.postDelayed({
                            if (isRunning) sendToAI(nextPrompt)
                        }, 10000)
                        
                        handler.postDelayed({ checkAiResponse() }, 15000)
                    }
                    return@thread
                }
            } else {
                val lines = screenText.trim().lines()
                if (lines.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val lastLine = lines.last().replace(Regex("\u001B\\[[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]"), "").trim()
                    if (lastLine.isNotEmpty() && lastLine.length < 100) runOnUiThread { updateStatus(lastLine) }
                }
            }
            handler.postDelayed({ readTerminalOutput(startMarker, endMarker, attempts + 1) }, 500)
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        isRunning = false
        handler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        super.onDestroy()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.app.Notification

import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat

class AgentForegroundService : Service() {
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        createNotificationChannel()
        val notification = createNotification()
        
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            startForeground(1, notification, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_DATA_SYNC)
        } else {
            startForeground(1, notification)
        }
        
        val powerManager = getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager
        wakeLock = powerManager.newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "LiteBrowser::AgentWakeLock")
        wakeLock?.acquire(60 * 60 * 1000L) // 1 hour max
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        wakeLock?.let {
            if (it.isHeld) it.release()
        }
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val channel = NotificationChannel(
                "agent_channel",
                "AI Agent Running",
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            )
            val manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
            manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }

    private fun createNotification(): Notification {
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, "agent_channel")
            .setContentTitle("AI Agent is Running")
            .setContentText("The agent is working in the background...")
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_launcher)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .build()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.Context
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import kotlin.concurrent.thread

object ApiClient {
    // آدرس API هرمز (سازگار با OpenAI)
    private const val BASE_URL = "https://api.hormouz.net/v1/chat/completions"
    
    fun sendPrompt(context: Context, apiKey: String, prompt: String, onResponse: (String) -> Unit, onError: (String) -> Unit) {
        thread {
            try {
                val url = URL(BASE_URL)
                val conn = url.openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
                conn.requestMethod = "POST"
                conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
                conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
                conn.doOutput = true
                conn.connectTimeout = 120000
                conn.readTimeout = 120000

                // ساخت بدنه JSON به صورت دستی
                val escapedPrompt = prompt.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\n", "\\n")
                val jsonBody = "{" +
                        "\"model\": \"nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free\"," +
                        "\"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"$escapedPrompt\"}]," +
                        "\"stream\": false" +
                        "}"

                val os = OutputStreamWriter(conn.outputStream)
                os.write(jsonBody)
                os.flush()
                os.close()

                val responseCode = conn.responseCode
                if (responseCode == HttpURLConnection.HTTP_OK) {
                    val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.inputStream))
                    val response = StringBuilder()
                    var line: String?
                    while (reader.readLine().also { line = it } != null) {
                        response.append(line)
                    }
                    reader.close()
                    
                    // استخراج محتوای پاسخ
                    val jsonString = response.toString()
                    val contentMatch = Regex("\"content\"\\s*:\\s*\"(.*?)\"").find(jsonString)
                    val content = contentMatch?.groupValues?.get(1)?.replace("\\n", "\n")?.replace("\\\"", "\"") ?: "Error parsing response"
                    onResponse(content)
                } else {
                    val errorStream = conn.errorStream?.bufferedReader()?.readText() ?: ""
                    onError("HTTP $responseCode: $errorStream")
                }
                conn.disconnect()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                onError("Network Error: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter
import android.widget.ListView
import android.widget.TextView
import java.io.File

class ChatHistoryActivity : Activity() {

    private lateinit var lvChats: ListView
    private var chatFiles: List<File> = emptyList()

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_chat_history)

        lvChats = findViewById(R.id.lv_chats)
        loadChats()
        
        lvChats.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, position, _ ->
            val selectedChat = chatFiles[position]
            showChatDetails(selectedChat)
        }
    }

    private fun loadChats() {
        chatFiles = ChatManager.getAllChats()
        
        val adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<File>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, chatFiles) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                val view = super.getView(position, convertView, parent)
                val textView = view.findViewById<TextView>(android.R.id.text1)
                textView.text = chatFiles[position].name.replace("_", " ")
                textView.textSize = 16f
                textView.setPadding(16, 24, 16, 24)
                return view
            }
        }
        
        lvChats.adapter = adapter
    }

    private fun showChatDetails(chatFolder: File) {
        val messages = ChatManager.loadChatHistory(chatFolder)
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        
        for (msg in messages) {
            when(msg.role) {
                "user" -> sb.append("👤 YOU:\n${msg.content}\n\n")
                "ai" -> sb.append("🤖 AI:\n${msg.content}\n\n")
                "terminal_output" -> sb.append("💻 TERMINAL:\n${msg.content}\n\n")
            }
        }
        
        if (sb.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("No messages saved yet.")
        }

        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(chatFolder.name)
            .setMessage(sb.toString())
            .setPositiveButton("Close", null)
            .show()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.os.Environment
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

data class ChatMessage(
    val role: String,
    val content: String,
    val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()
)

object ChatManager {
    private val baseDir = File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS), "Local_AI_Models/Agent_Chats")

    init {
        if (!baseDir.exists()) baseDir.mkdirs()
    }

    fun sanitizeFileName(input: String): String {
        var clean = input.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "")
        clean = clean.replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9_\\-\\u0600-\\u06FF]"), "_")
        if (clean.length > 40) clean = clean.substring(0, 40)
        return clean.trim('_')
    }

    fun createNewChat(prompt: String): File {
        val dateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm", Locale.US)
        val timestamp = dateFormat.format(Date())
        val safeTitle = sanitizeFileName(prompt)
        val folderName = "${timestamp}_${safeTitle}"
        
        val chatFolder = File(baseDir, folderName)
        if (!chatFolder.exists()) chatFolder.mkdirs()
        
        saveChatHistory(chatFolder, emptyList())
        return chatFolder
    }

    fun saveChatHistory(chatFolder: File, messages: List<ChatMessage>) {
        try {
            val jsonArray = JSONArray()
            for (msg in messages) {
                val jsonObj = JSONObject()
                jsonObj.put("role", msg.role)
                jsonObj.put("content", msg.content)
                jsonObj.put("timestamp", msg.timestamp)
                jsonArray.put(jsonObj)
            }
            val file = File(chatFolder, "chat_history.json")
            file.writeText(jsonArray.toString(2))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("ChatManager", "Failed to save chat history", e)
        }
    }

    fun loadChatHistory(chatFolder: File): List<ChatMessage> {
        val messages = mutableListOf<ChatMessage>()
        try {
            val file = File(chatFolder, "chat_history.json")
            if (file.exists()) {
                val jsonArray = JSONArray(file.readText())
                for (i in 0 until jsonArray.length()) {
                    val jsonObj = jsonArray.getJSONObject(i)
                    messages.add(ChatMessage(
                        jsonObj.getString("role"),
                        jsonObj.getString("content"),
                        jsonObj.getLong("timestamp")
                    ))
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("ChatManager", "Failed to load chat history", e)
        }
        return messages
    }

    fun getAllChats(): List<File> {
        return baseDir.listFiles { file -> file.isDirectory }?.sortedByDescending { it.name } ?: emptyList()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.Context
import android.system.Os
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveInputStream
import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveEntry

object DistroInstaller {

    private const val DISTRO = "alpine"
    private const val ASSET_NAME = "alpine-rootfs.bin"

    fun isInstalled(context: Context): Boolean {
        val rootfs = File(context.filesDir, "usr/var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/$DISTRO")
        // ✅ بررسی فایل اصلی busybox به جای لینک نمادین sh
        return File(rootfs, "bin/busybox").exists() || File(rootfs, "etc/alpine-release").exists()
    }

    fun install(context: Context, onProgress: (String) -> Unit = {}) {
        try {
            val prefix = File(context.filesDir, "usr")
            val installed = File(prefix, "var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/$DISTRO")
            
            if (installed.exists()) {
                installed.deleteRecursively()
            }
            installed.mkdirs()

            onProgress("Extracting Alpine rootfs...")
            Logger.i("DistroInstaller", "Extracting to ${installed.absolutePath}")

            context.assets.open(ASSET_NAME).use { input ->
                GZIPInputStream(input).use { gzip ->
                    TarArchiveInputStream(gzip).use { tar ->
                        var entry: TarArchiveEntry? = tar.nextEntry
                        var count = 0
                        
                        while (entry != null) {
                            val outFile = File(installed, entry.name)
                            
                            if (entry.isDirectory) {
                                outFile.mkdirs()
                            } else if (entry.isSymbolicLink) {
                                outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                                try {
                                    if (outFile.exists()) outFile.delete()
                                    Os.symlink(entry.linkName, outFile.absolutePath)
                                } catch (e: Exception) {
                                    Logger.e("DistroInstaller", "Symlink failed: ${entry.name} -> ${entry.linkName}", e)
                                }
                            } else if (entry.isLink) {
                                outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                                val target = File(installed, entry.linkName)
                                if (target.exists()) {
                                    target.copyTo(outFile, overwrite = true)
                                }
                            } else {
                                outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                                FileOutputStream(outFile).use { out ->
                                    tar.copyTo(out)
                                }
                                if (entry.mode and 0x40 != 0) {
                                    outFile.setExecutable(true)
                                }
                            }
                            count++
                            if (count % 200 == 0) onProgress("Extracted $count entries...")
                            entry = tar.nextEntry
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // ✅ بررسی نهایی با busybox
            val busyboxFile = File(installed, "bin/busybox")
            if (busyboxFile.exists()) {
                Logger.i("DistroInstaller", "✅ Alpine installed successfully.")
                onProgress("Done.")
            } else {
                Logger.e("DistroInstaller", "❌ busybox still missing!")
                onProgress("Error: busybox not found")
            }
            
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("DistroInstaller", "install failed", e)
            onProgress("Error: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Environment
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import java.io.File
import android.widget.*

class FileManagerActivity : Activity() {

    private lateinit var lvFiles: ListView
    private lateinit var tvPath: TextView
    private lateinit var tvEmpty: TextView
    private val downloadsRoot: File = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
    private var currentDir: File = downloadsRoot
    private val files = mutableListOf<File>()
    private val displayItems = mutableListOf<String>()
    private lateinit var adapter: ArrayAdapter<String>

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_file_manager)

        tvPath = findViewById(R.id.tv_fm_path)
        lvFiles = findViewById(R.id.lv_fm_files)
        tvEmpty = findViewById(R.id.tv_fm_empty)

        findViewById<Button>(R.id.btn_fm_back).setOnClickListener { finish() }
        findViewById<Button>(R.id.btn_fm_up).setOnClickListener { goUp() }
        findViewById<Button>(R.id.btn_fm_refresh).setOnClickListener { loadFiles() }

        adapter = object : ArrayAdapter<String>(this, android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1, displayItems) {
            override fun getView(position: Int, convertView: View?, parent: ViewGroup): View {
                val v = super.getView(position, convertView, parent)
                v.findViewById<TextView>(android.R.id.text1).apply {
                    textSize = 13f
                    setPadding(16, 20, 16, 20)
                    typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
                }
                return v
            }
        }
        lvFiles.adapter = adapter

        lvFiles.setOnItemClickListener { _, _, pos, _ ->
            val file = files[pos]
            if (file.isDirectory) { currentDir = file; loadFiles() } else openFile(file)
        }
        lvFiles.setOnItemLongClickListener { _, _, pos, _ -> showFileOptions(files[pos]); true }

        if (!downloadsRoot.exists()) downloadsRoot.mkdirs()
        loadFiles()
    }

    private fun loadFiles() {
        files.clear(); displayItems.clear()
        val list = currentDir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name.lowercase() }
        ) ?: emptyList()
        files.addAll(list)
        list.forEach { f ->
            val icon = when {
                f.isDirectory -> "📁"
                f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("txt","md","log","json","py","sh","kt","java","xml","yml","yaml","conf","cfg","html","css","js","c","cpp","h","rs","go","rb","php","sql","csv") -> "📄"
                f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("jpg","jpeg","png","gif","bmp","webp") -> "🖼️"
                f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("mp3","wav","ogg","m4a") -> "🎵"
                f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("mp4","mkv","avi","mov") -> "🎬"
                f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("zip","tar","gz","xz","bz2","7z","rar") -> "📦"
                f.extension.lowercase() == "apk" -> "📱"
                else -> "📎"
            }
            val size = if (f.isDirectory) "<dir>" else formatSize(f.length())
            displayItems.add("$icon  ${f.name}\n      $size")
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        tvPath.text = currentDir.absolutePath
        tvEmpty.visibility = if (files.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
    }

    private fun goUp() {
        val parent = currentDir.parentFile ?: return
        if (!parent.canRead()) { Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot read parent", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); return }
        currentDir = parent; loadFiles()
    }

    private fun formatSize(bytes: Long): String = when {
        bytes < 1024 -> "$bytes B"
        bytes < 1024 * 1024 -> "${bytes / 1024} KB"
        bytes < 1024L * 1024 * 1024 -> "${bytes / (1024 * 1024)} MB"
        else -> "${bytes / (1024L * 1024 * 1024)} GB"
    }

    private fun isTextFile(f: File): Boolean = f.extension.lowercase() in listOf(
        "txt","md","log","json","py","sh","kt","java","xml","yml","yaml","conf","cfg",
        "html","css","js","c","cpp","h","rs","go","rb","php","sql","csv","ini","toml"
    )
    private fun isImageFile(f: File): Boolean = f.extension.lowercase() in listOf("jpg","jpeg","png","gif","bmp","webp")

    private fun openFile(f: File) {
        when {
            isTextFile(f) -> showText(f)
            isImageFile(f) -> showImage(f)
            else -> showOpenWith(f)
        }
    }

    private fun showText(f: File) {
        try {
            val maxSize = 1024 * 1024
            val content = if (f.length() > maxSize) {
                f.inputStream().use { stream ->
                    val buf = ByteArray(500 * 1024)
                    val n = stream.read(buf)
                    String(buf, 0, n) + "\n\n... (truncated, file is ${formatSize(f.length())})"
                }
            } else f.readText()

            val scroll = ScrollView(this)
            val tv = TextView(this)
            tv.text = content
            tv.setTextIsSelectable(true)
            tv.textSize = 11f
            tv.typeface = Typeface.MONOSPACE
            tv.setPadding(20, 20, 20, 20)
            scroll.addView(tv)

            AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(f.name)
                .setView(scroll)
                .setPositiveButton("Close", null)
                .setNeutralButton("Copy All") { _, _ ->
                    val cm = getSystemService(CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                    cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText(f.name, content))
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Copied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
                .show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun showImage(f: File) {
        try {
            if (f.length() > 20L * 1024 * 1024) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Image too large (>20MB)", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); return
            }
            val opts = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
            BitmapFactory.decodeFile(f.absolutePath, opts)
            val maxDim = 2048
            if (opts.outWidth > maxDim || opts.outHeight > maxDim) {
                opts.inSampleSize = maxOf(opts.outWidth / maxDim, opts.outHeight / maxDim, 1)
            }
            opts.inJustDecodeBounds = false
            val bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(f.absolutePath, opts)
            if (bmp == null) { Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot load image", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); return }
            val iv = ImageView(this).apply { setImageBitmap(bmp); adjustViewBounds = true; setPadding(20, 20, 20, 20) }
            AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("${f.name} (${bmp.width}x${bmp.height})")
                .setView(iv)
                .setPositiveButton("Close", null)
                .show()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Error: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun showOpenWith(f: File) {
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(f.name)
            .setMessage("This file type is not supported for inline viewing.\n\nOpen with external app?")
            .setPositiveButton("Open") { _, _ ->
                try {
                    val ext = f.extension.lowercase()
                    val mime = android.webkit.MimeTypeMap.getSingleton().getMimeTypeFromExtension(ext) ?: "*/*"
                    val uri = androidx.core.content.FileProvider.getUriForFile(
                        this, "$packageName.fileprovider", f
                    )
                    val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
                        setDataAndType(uri, mime)
                        addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
                    }
                    startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Open with"))
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showFileOptions(f: File) {
        val options = arrayOf("🗑️  Delete", "📋  Copy Path", "🔗  Share")
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(f.name)
            .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                when (which) {
                    0 -> confirmDelete(f)
                    1 -> {
                        val cm = getSystemService(CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                        cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("path", f.absolutePath))
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Path copied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    }
                    2 -> shareFile(f)
                }
            }
            .show()
    }

    private fun shareFile(f: File) {
        try {
            val uri = androidx.core.content.FileProvider.getUriForFile(this, "$packageName.fileprovider", f)
            val ext = f.extension.lowercase()
            val mime = android.webkit.MimeTypeMap.getSingleton().getMimeTypeFromExtension(ext) ?: "*/*"
            val share = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                type = mime
                putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri)
                addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
            }
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(share, "Share"))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot share: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun confirmDelete(f: File) {
        val size = formatSize(f.length())
        val warning = if (f.isDirectory) "\n\n⚠️ This is a DIRECTORY. All contents will be deleted!" else ""
        AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle("⚠️ Delete File?")
            .setMessage("Name: ${f.name}\nSize: $size\nPath: ${f.absolutePath}$warning")
            .setPositiveButton("Yes, Delete") { _, _ ->
                val ok = if (f.isDirectory) f.deleteRecursively() else f.delete()
                if (ok) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Deleted: ${f.name}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    loadFiles()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Delete failed", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .setNeutralButton("Copy Path") { _, _ ->
                val cm = getSystemService(CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager
                cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("path", f.absolutePath))
            }
            .show()
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (currentDir.absolutePath != downloadsRoot.absolutePath && currentDir.parentFile != null && currentDir.parentFile.canRead()) {
            currentDir = currentDir.parentFile!!
            loadFiles()
        } else super.onBackPressed()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.app.Application
import android.content.Context
import android.net.ConnectivityManager
import android.net.LinkProperties
import android.net.Network
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import java.io.File

class LiteApp : Application() {

    private var networkCallback: ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback? = null

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        Logger.reset()
        Logger.i("App", "========== APP START ==========")
        Logger.i("App", "Android SDK: ${android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT}")
        Logger.i("App", "Device: ${android.os.Build.MODEL} (${android.os.Build.DEVICE})")
        Logger.i("App", "ABI: ${android.os.Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.joinToString(",")}")

        try {
            NativeInstaller.install(this)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("App", "NativeInstaller failed", e)
        }

        Thread {
            try {
                if (!DistroInstaller.isInstalled(this)) {
                    Logger.i("App", "Alpine not installed yet, installing...")
                    DistroInstaller.install(this) { msg -> Logger.i("App", msg) }
                } else {
                    Logger.i("App", "Alpine already installed")
                }
                // Write DNS config after install
                writeDnsConfig()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Logger.e("App", "DistroInstaller failed", e)
            }
        }.start()

        registerNetworkCallback()

        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler { thread, ex ->
            Logger.crash(thread, ex)
        }
    }

    private fun registerNetworkCallback() {
        try {
            val cm = getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as ConnectivityManager
            networkCallback = object : ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
                override fun onAvailable(network: Network) { writeDnsConfig() }
                override fun onLinkPropertiesChanged(network: Network, linkProperties: LinkProperties) { writeDnsConfig() }
            }
            cm.registerDefaultNetworkCallback(networkCallback!!)
            Logger.i("DNS", "Network callback registered")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("DNS", "Failed to register network callback", e)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Writes DNS servers from Android to a resolv.conf file that can be bind-mounted into Alpine.
     * Also writes a fallback directly into the extracted rootfs (for TerminalActivity without bind).
     */
    fun writeDnsConfig() {
        try {
            val dnsServers = getProotHost().dnsServers
            
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            val ipv4 = dnsServers.filter { !it.contains(":") }
            val ipv6 = dnsServers.filter { it.contains(":") }
            
            if (ipv4.isNotEmpty()) {
                ipv4.forEach { sb.append("nameserver $it\n") }
            }
            if (ipv6.isNotEmpty()) {
                ipv6.take(2).forEach { sb.append("nameserver $it\n") }
            }
            if (sb.isEmpty()) {
                // Fallback
                sb.append("nameserver 8.8.8.8\n")
                sb.append("nameserver 1.1.1.1\n")
                sb.append("nameserver 8.8.4.4\n")
            }
            val content = sb.toString()

            // Primary: for bind mount
            val etcDir = File(filesDir, "etc").also { it.mkdirs() }
            File(etcDir, "resolv.conf").writeText(content)

            // Fallback: write directly into Alpine rootfs (covers TerminalActivity)
            val alpineResolv = File(filesDir, "usr/var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/alpine/etc/resolv.conf")
            if (alpineResolv.parentFile?.exists() == true) {
                alpineResolv.writeText(content)
            }

            Logger.i("DNS", "Wrote resolv.conf with $dnsServers")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("DNS", "Failed to write DNS", e)
        }
    }

    fun getProotHost(): ProotHost = object : ProotHost {
        override val prefixDir: File get() = File(filesDir, "usr").also { it.mkdirs() }
        override val homeDir: File get() = File(filesDir, "home").also { it.mkdirs() }
        override val cacheDir: File get() = this@LiteApp.cacheDir
        override val packageName: String get() = this@LiteApp.packageName
        override val dnsServers: List<String>
            get() {
                return try {
                    val cm = getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as ConnectivityManager
                    val network = cm.activeNetwork ?: return emptyList()
                    val linkProps = cm.getLinkProperties(network) ?: return emptyList()
                    linkProps.dnsServers.mapNotNull { it.hostAddress }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    emptyList()
                }
            }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.util.Log
import java.io.File
import java.io.PrintWriter
import java.io.StringWriter
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

object Logger {
    private const val TAG = "LiteBrowser"
    private val logFile: File by lazy {
        File("/storage/emulated/0/Download/LiteBrowser.log")
    }
    private val timeFmt = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US)

    @Synchronized
    fun i(tag: String, msg: String) {
        Log.i("$TAG/$tag", msg)
        write("I", tag, msg)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun d(tag: String, msg: String) {
        Log.d("$TAG/$tag", msg)
        write("D", tag, msg)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun w(tag: String, msg: String) {
        Log.w("$TAG/$tag", msg)
        write("W", tag, msg)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun e(tag: String, msg: String, e: Throwable? = null) {
        Log.e("$TAG/$tag", msg, e)
        val full = if (e != null) "$msg\n${stackTraceOf(e)}" else msg
        write("E", tag, full)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun crash(thread: Thread, ex: Throwable) {
        write("CRASH", thread.name, stackTraceOf(ex))
        Log.e(TAG, "CRASH on ${thread.name}", ex)
    }

    private fun stackTraceOf(e: Throwable): String {
        val sw = StringWriter()
        e.printStackTrace(PrintWriter(sw))
        return sw.toString()
    }

    private fun write(level: String, tag: String, msg: String) {
        try {
            val time = timeFmt.format(Date())
            // هر خط را جداگانه با indentation مینویسیم
            val lines = msg.split("\n")
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            for (line in lines) {
                sb.append(time).append(" [").append(level).append("] [").append(tag).append("] ").append(line).append("\n")
            }
            logFile.appendText(sb.toString())
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            // اگر نوشتن فایل شکست خورد (مثلاً دسترسی نیست) حداقل در logcat ثبت شود
            Log.e(TAG, "Cannot write log file: ${ex.message}")
        }
    }

    /** پاک کردن فایل لاگ — برای شروع تمیز در هر اجرا */
    fun reset() {
        try {
            logFile.writeText("")
            write("I", "Logger", "=== Log file reset at app start ===")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Cannot reset log file: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.Manifest
import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Environment
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.KeyEvent
import android.webkit.WebView
import android.webkit.WebViewClient
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Toast
import java.io.File

class MainActivity : Activity() {

    private lateinit var webView: WebView
    private lateinit var urlBar: EditText
    private lateinit var btnReload: Button
    private lateinit var btnNavBrowser: Button
    private lateinit var btnNavAgent: Button
    private lateinit var btnNavTerminal: Button
    private lateinit var btnNavFiles: Button
    private lateinit var btnNavTools: Button
    private var isAiWatcherRunning = true

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        Logger.i("Browser", "onCreate() called")
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_browser)
        PrivilegeManager.requestPermission()

        webView = findViewById(R.id.webview)
        urlBar = findViewById(R.id.url_bar)
        btnReload = findViewById(R.id.btn_reload)
        btnNavBrowser = findViewById(R.id.btn_nav_browser)
        btnNavAgent = findViewById(R.id.btn_nav_agent)
        btnNavTerminal = findViewById(R.id.btn_nav_terminal)
        btnNavFiles = findViewById(R.id.btn_nav_files)
        btnNavTools = findViewById(R.id.btn_nav_tools)

        webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true
        webView.settings.domStorageEnabled = true
        webView.addJavascriptInterface(WebAppInterface(this, webView), "AndroidBridge")

        webView.webViewClient = object : WebViewClient() {
            override fun onPageStarted(view: WebView?, url: String?, favicon: Bitmap?) {
                super.onPageStarted(view, url, favicon)
                urlBar.setText(url ?: "")
            }
        }

        urlBar.setOnKeyListener { _, keyCode, event ->
            if (keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER && event.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                loadUrlOrSearch(urlBar.text.toString().trim()); true
            } else false
        }

        btnReload.setOnClickListener { webView.reload() }
        btnNavBrowser.setOnClickListener { /* Already on Browser */ }
        btnNavAgent.setOnClickListener { startActivity(Intent(this, AgentActivity::class.java)) }
        btnNavTerminal.setOnClickListener { startActivity(Intent(this, TerminalActivity::class.java)) }
        btnNavFiles.setOnClickListener { startActivity(Intent(this, FileManagerActivity::class.java)) }
        btnNavTools.setOnClickListener { startActivity(Intent(this, ToolsActivity::class.java)) }

        webView.loadUrl("https://chat.deepseek.com/")
        requestStoragePermission()
        startAiWatcher()
    }

    private fun startAiWatcher() {
        val reqFile = File(filesDir, "home/ai_req.txt")
        Thread {
            while (isAiWatcherRunning) {
                if (reqFile.exists()) {
                    val base64Prompt = reqFile.readText().trim()
                    val prompt = try {
                        String(android.util.Base64.decode(base64Prompt, android.util.Base64.NO_WRAP))
                    } catch (e: Exception) { base64Prompt }
                    reqFile.delete()
                    runOnUiThread { executeAiPrompt(prompt) }
                }
                try { Thread.sleep(500) } catch (e: InterruptedException) { break }
            }
        }.start()
    }

    private fun executeAiPrompt(prompt: String) {
        val safePrompt = prompt.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "")
        val js = """
            (function() {
                var ta = document.querySelector('textarea');
                if (!ta) {
                    AndroidBridge.onAiError("Textarea not found. Are you logged in and on the chat page?");
                    return;
                }
                ta.focus();
                document.execCommand('selectAll', false, null);
                document.execCommand('insertText', false, "$safePrompt");
                setTimeout(function() {
                    ta.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
                    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button, div[role="button"]');
                    for (var i = buttons.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        var btn = buttons[i];
                        if (btn.querySelector('svg') && btn.offsetWidth > 0) {
                            var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
                            var taRect = ta.getBoundingClientRect();
                            if (rect.left > taRect.left + (taRect.width / 2)) { btn.click(); break; }
                        }
                    }
                    var lastText = "";
                    var stableCount = 0;
                    var attempts = 0;
                    var interval = setInterval(function() {
                        attempts++;
                        var msgs = document.querySelectorAll('.ds-markdown');
                        if (msgs.length > 0) {
                            var clone = msgs[msgs.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
                            var btns = clone.querySelectorAll('button, .ds-icon-button');
                            for(var j=0; j<btns.length; j++) { btns[j].remove(); }
                            var currentText = clone.innerText;
                            if (currentText === lastText && currentText.length > 0) {
                                stableCount++;
                                if (stableCount >= 4) {
                                    clearInterval(interval);
                                    AndroidBridge.onAiResponse(currentText);
                                }
                            } else { stableCount = 0; lastText = currentText; }
                        }
                        if (attempts > 600) { clearInterval(interval); AndroidBridge.onAiError("Timeout waiting for AI response"); }
                    }, 500);
                }, 500);
            })();
        """.trimIndent()
        webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null)
        Toast.makeText(this, "Question sent to AI...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() { isAiWatcherRunning = false; super.onDestroy() }

    private fun requestStoragePermission() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                if (!Environment.isExternalStorageManager()) {
                    val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION)
                    intent.data = Uri.parse("package:$packageName")
                    startActivity(intent)
                }
            } else {
                if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE), 100)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) { Logger.e("Browser", "requestStoragePermission failed", e) }
    }

    private fun loadUrlOrSearch(input: String) {
        if (input.isEmpty()) return
        var url = input
        if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) {
            url = if (url.contains(".") && !url.contains(" ")) "https://$url"
            else "https://www.google.com/search?q=" + Uri.encode(url)
        }
        webView.loadUrl(url)
    }

    override fun onBackPressed() {
        if (webView.canGoBack()) webView.goBack() else super.onBackPressed()
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.Context
import android.system.Os
import java.io.File

object NativeInstaller {

    private data class NativeCopy(val libName: String, val destRel: String)

    private val FILES = listOf(
        NativeCopy("libbusybox.so", "bin/busybox"),
        NativeCopy("libpr-cli.so", "bin/pr-cli"),
        NativeCopy("libproot.so", "lib/libproot.so"),
        NativeCopy("libproot-loader.so", "lib/libproot-loader.so"),
        NativeCopy("libtalloc.so", "lib/libtalloc.so.2")
    )

    fun nativeDir(c: Context) = File(c.applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir)

    fun prootBin(c: Context): File {
        val n = File(nativeDir(c), "libproot.so")
        return if (n.exists()) n else File(c.filesDir, "usr/lib/libproot.so")
    }

    fun prootLoader(c: Context): File {
        val n = File(nativeDir(c), "libproot-loader.so")
        return if (n.exists()) n else File(c.filesDir, "usr/lib/libproot-loader.so")
    }

    private fun dumpAndroidProps(context: Context) {
        try {
            val propsFile = File(context.filesDir, "home/Android_Props.txt")
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            val props = listOf(
                "ro.product.brand", "ro.product.manufacturer", "ro.product.model",
                "ro.product.device", "ro.product.name", "ro.build.fingerprint",
                "ro.build.id", "ro.build.type", "ro.build.tags",
                "ro.build.version.release", "ro.build.version.sdk",
                "ro.build.version.security_patch", "ro.bootloader",
                "gsm.version.baseband", "ro.serialno", "ro.build.date",
                "ro.hardware", "ro.board.platform", "ro.soc.manufacturer",
                "ro.soc.model", "ro.opengles.version", "ro.hardware.egl",
                "ro.hardware.vulkan"
            )
            for (prop in props) {
                val value = try {
                    val p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(arrayOf("/system/bin/getprop", prop))
                    p.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText().trim().ifEmpty { "N/A" }
                } catch (e: Exception) { "N/A" }
                sb.append(prop).append("=").append(value).append("\n")
            }
            propsFile.writeText(sb.toString())
            Logger.i("NativeInstaller", "Android props dumped to " + propsFile.absolutePath)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("NativeInstaller", "Failed to dump Android props", e)
        }
    }

    fun install(context: Context) {
        try {
            if (PrivilegeManager.isShizukuAvailable()) {
                PrivilegeManager.grantAllPermissions(context.packageName)
            } else {
                Logger.w("NativeInstaller", "Shizuku not available, falling back to manual grants")
            }
            val prefix = File(context.filesDir, "usr")
            File(prefix, "bin").mkdirs()
            File(prefix, "lib").mkdirs()
            File(context.filesDir, "home").mkdirs()

            val tmpDir = File(context.cacheDir, "proot-tmp")
            tmpDir.mkdirs()
            tmpDir.setReadable(true, false)
            tmpDir.setWritable(true, false)
            tmpDir.setExecutable(true, false)

            val alpineRoot = File(prefix, "var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/alpine")
            for (d in listOf("tmp", "proc", "sys", "dev", "etc", "dev/pts", "dev/shm")) {
                File(alpineRoot, d).mkdirs()
            }
            File(alpineRoot, "etc/resolv.conf").writeText("nameserver 8.8.8.8\nnameserver 1.1.1.1\n")

            val nativeDir = nativeDir(context)
            Logger.i("NativeInstaller", "nativeLibraryDir=${nativeDir.absolutePath}")
            Logger.i("NativeInstaller", "contents=${nativeDir.list()?.joinToString(",")}")

            for (copy in FILES) {
                val dest = File(prefix, copy.destRel)
                val src = File(nativeDir, copy.libName)
                try {
                    if (src.exists()) {
                        if (!dest.exists() || dest.length() != src.length()) {
                            dest.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                            src.copyTo(dest, overwrite = true)
                        }
                        Os.chmod(dest.absolutePath, 493)
                        Logger.i("NativeInstaller", "OK ${dest.absolutePath} size=${dest.length()}")
                    } else {
                        Logger.w("NativeInstaller", "missing in nativeDir: ${copy.libName}")
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Logger.e("NativeInstaller", "Failed ${copy.libName}", e)
                }
            }

            val askScript = File(prefix, "bin/ask")
            askScript.writeText("""
                #!/bin/sh
                if [ -z "${'$'}1" ]; then
                    echo "Usage: ask <prompt>"
                    exit 1
                fi
                REQ_FILE="/root/ai_req.txt"
                RES_FILE="/root/ai_res.txt"
                rm -f "${'$'}RES_FILE"
                echo -n "${'$'}*" | base64 | tr -d '\n' > "${'$'}REQ_FILE"
                echo -e "\033[33mWaiting for AI... (Switch to browser if it is not open)\033[0m" >&2
                count=0
                while [ ! -f "${'$'}RES_FILE" ]; do
                    sleep 0.5
                    count=${'$'}((count+1))
                    if [ ${'$'}count -ge 600 ]; then
                        echo -e "\033[31mError: Timeout waiting for AI response\033[0m" >&2
                        rm -f "${'$'}REQ_FILE"
                        exit 1
                    fi
                done
                echo -e "\033[32mAI:\033[0m"
                base64 -d "${'$'}RES_FILE"
                echo ""
                rm -f "${'$'}REQ_FILE" "${'$'}RES_FILE"
            """.trimIndent())
            Os.chmod(askScript.absolutePath, 493)
            Logger.i("NativeInstaller", "ask script installed")
            dumpAndroidProps(context)

            for (lib in listOf("libpr-cli.so", "libproot.so", "libproot-loader.so")) {
                val src = File(nativeDir, lib)
                if (src.exists()) {
                    val simpleName = lib.removePrefix("lib").removeSuffix(".so")
                    val link = File(prefix, "bin/$simpleName")
                    try {
                        if (!link.exists()) Os.symlink(src.absolutePath, link.absolutePath)
                    } catch (_: Exception) {}
                }
            }

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("NativeInstaller", "install failed", e)
        }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import rikka.shizuku.Shizuku

object PrivilegeManager {
    private const val REQUEST_CODE = 1001

    fun isShizukuAvailable(): Boolean {
        return try {
            Shizuku.pingBinder() && Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    fun requestPermission() {
        try {
            if (Shizuku.isPreV11()) return
            if (Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return
            Shizuku.requestPermission(REQUEST_CODE)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("PrivilegeManager", "requestPermission failed", e)
        }
    }

    fun executeShell(command: String): String {
        if (!isShizukuAvailable()) return "Shizuku not available"
        return try {
            val process = Shizuku.newProcess(arrayOf("sh", "-c", command), null, null)
            val output = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
            process.waitFor()
            output
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.e("PrivilegeManager", "executeShell failed: " + command, e)
            "Error: " + e.message
        }
    }

    fun grantAllPermissions(packageName: String) {
        val permissions = listOf(
            "android.permission.CAMERA",
            "android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO",
            "android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION",
            "android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION",
            "android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS",
            "android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE",
            "android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE",
            "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES",
            "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO",
            "android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO"
        )
        for (perm in permissions) {
            executeShell("pm grant " + packageName + " " + perm)
        }
        executeShell("appops set --uid " + packageName + " MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE allow")
        executeShell("appops set " + packageName + " SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow")
        Logger.i("PrivilegeManager", "All permissions granted via Shizuku")
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.Context
import com.termux.terminal.TerminalSession
import java.io.File

object SessionFactory {

    const val DOWNLOAD_HOST = "/storage/emulated/0/Download"
    const val CACHE_HOST = "/storage/emulated/0/Download/Local_AI_Models/Library_Cache"

    fun createSession(context: Context, viewWidth: Int, viewHeight: Int): TerminalSession? {
        return try {
            val app = context.applicationContext as LiteApp
            val prefixDir = File(app.filesDir, "usr")
            val homeDir = File(app.filesDir, "home").also { it.mkdirs() }
            val tmpDir = File(app.cacheDir, "proot-tmp").also { it.mkdirs() }
            val nativeDir = app.applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir
            val resolvConfHost = File(app.filesDir, "etc/resolv.conf")

            val alpineRoot = File(prefixDir, "var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/alpine")
            if (!alpineRoot.exists() || !File(alpineRoot, "bin/busybox").exists()) {
                Logger.e("SessionFactory", "Alpine rootfs missing at $alpineRoot")
                return null
            }

            File(DOWNLOAD_HOST).mkdirs()
            File(CACHE_HOST).mkdirs()

            val prootBin = File(nativeDir, "libproot.so")
            val prootLoader = File(nativeDir, "libproot-loader.so")

            if (!prootBin.exists()) {
                Logger.e("SessionFactory", "libproot.so not found in $nativeDir")
                return null
            }

            val envVars = arrayOf(
                "PATH=${nativeDir}:${prefixDir.absolutePath}/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin",
                "HOME=${homeDir.absolutePath}",
                "PREFIX=${prefixDir.absolutePath}",
                "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${nativeDir}:${prefixDir.absolutePath}/lib",
                "APP_PREFIX=${prefixDir.absolutePath}",
                "APP_HOME=${homeDir.absolutePath}",
                "APP_PACKAGE=${app.packageName}",
                "PROOT_LOADER=${prootLoader.absolutePath}",
                "PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1",
                "PROOT_TMP_DIR=${tmpDir.absolutePath}",
                "TMPDIR=${tmpDir.absolutePath}",
                "TERM=xterm-256color",
                "LANG=C.UTF-8",
                "LC_ALL=C.UTF-8"
            )

            val args = arrayOf(
                prootBin.absolutePath, "--link2symlink", "-0",
                "-r", alpineRoot.absolutePath,
                "-b", "/dev",
                "-b", "/proc",
                "-b", "/sys",
                "-b", "${homeDir.absolutePath}:/root",
                "-b", "${DOWNLOAD_HOST}:/root/Download",
                "-b", "${prefixDir.absolutePath}/bin:/usr/local/bin",
                "-b", "${resolvConfHost.absolutePath}:/etc/resolv.conf",
                "-b", "/system:/system",
                "-b", "/data:/data",
                "-b", "/sdcard:/sdcard",
                "-b", "/vendor:/vendor",
                "-w", "/root",
                "/bin/sh", "-l"
            )

            val session = TerminalSession(
                prootBin.absolutePath,
                homeDir.absolutePath,
                args,
                envVars,
                2000,
                TerminalManager
            )
            session.updateSize(80.coerceAtLeast(20), 24.coerceAtLeast(8))
            Logger.i("SessionFactory", "Session created pid=${session.getPid()}")
            session
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            Logger.e("SessionFactory", "create failed", e)
            null
        }
    }
}

package com.litebrowser

import android.content.Context
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

class Store(c: Context) {
    private val p = c.getSharedPreferences("lite", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    fun get(k: String): List<Pair<String, String>> = try {
        val a = JSONArray(p.getString(k, "[]"))
        (0 until a.length()).map { val o = a.getJSONObject(it); o.getString("t") to o.getString("u") }
    } catch (e: Exception) { emptyList() }

    private fun put(k: String, l: List<Pair<String, String>>) {
        val a = JSONArray()
        l.forEach { a.put(JSONObject().put("t", it.first).put("u", it.second)) }
        p.edit().putString(k, a.toString()).apply()
    }

    fun add(k: String, t: String, u: String, max: Int) {
        val l = get(k).filter { it.second != u }.toMutableList()
        l.add(0, t to u); put(k, l.take(max))
    }
    fun remove(k: String, u: String) = put(k, get(k).filter { it.second != u })
    fun has(k: String, u: String) = get(k).any { it.second == u }
    fun clear(k: String) = p.edit().remove(k).apply()
    fun flag(k: String) = p.getBoolean(k, false)
    fun setFlag(k: String) = p.edit().putBoolean(k, true).apply()
    var session: String
        get() = p.getString("session", "") ?: ""
        set(v) { p.edit().putString("session", v).apply() }
}

FILE: ./app/src/main/java/com/litebrowser/TerminalActivity.kt
