package id.or.oo.pr

import id.or.oo.pr.DistroOperations.Kind
import id.or.oo.pr.session.DistroCommand
import id.or.oo.pr.session.FakePty
import id.or.oo.pr.session.ManagedSession
import id.or.oo.pr.session.SessionManager
import id.or.oo.pr.session.eventually
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.asCoroutineDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
import kotlinx.coroutines.runInterruptible
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.IOException
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executor

class DistroOperationsTest {

    private class FakeCommand : DistroCommand {
        val calls = CopyOnWriteArrayList<List<String>>()
        val runningAtCall = CopyOnWriteArrayList<List<String>>()
        @Volatile var sessions: SessionManager? = null
        @Volatile var before = listOf<String>()
        @Volatile var after = listOf<String>()
        @Volatile var exitCode = 0
        @Volatile var failure: Exception? = null
        @Volatile var gate: CountDownLatch? = null
        @Volatile var sawCancellation = false
        @Volatile var failureOnCancel: Exception? = null
        @Volatile var gatedCommand: String? = null
        @Volatile var linesFor = mapOf<String, List<String>>()
        @Volatile var uninterruptibleGate: CountDownLatch? = null

        override suspend fun run(args: List<String>, onLine: (String) -> Unit): Int {
            calls += args
            sessions?.let { runningAtCall += it.running.value }
            before.forEach(onLine)
            linesFor[args.first()].orEmpty().forEach(onLine)
            try {
                gate?.takeIf { gatedCommand == null || gatedCommand == args.first() }
                    ?.let { runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) { it.await() } }
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                sawCancellation = true
                throw failureOnCancel ?: e
            }
            uninterruptibleGate?.await()
            after.forEach(onLine)
            failure?.let { throw it }
            return exitCode
        }
    }

    private val ptys = ConcurrentHashMap<String, FakePty>()
    @Volatile private var endGraceMs = 100L

    private val sessions = SessionManager(
        { alias, onEnded ->
            val pty = FakePty()
            ptys[alias] = pty
            ManagedSession(alias, pty, null, { _, _, _ -> }, onEnded, endGraceMs = endGraceMs, exitCodeWaitMs = 100)
        },
        object : SessionManager.ForegroundController {
            override fun start() {}
        },
    ) { _, _ -> }

    private val command = FakeCommand().also { it.sessions = sessions }
    private val installed: MutableSet<String> = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet()
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)

    private fun operations(endTimeoutMs: Long = ManagedSession.END_TIMEOUT_MS) =
        DistroOperations(command, sessions, scope, { it in installed }, endTimeoutMs)

    private fun DistroOperations.awaitFinished(): DistroOperations.Operation {
        eventually { operation.value?.running == false }
        return operation.value!!
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        command.gate?.countDown()
        ptys.values.forEach { it.exit(0) }
        scope.cancel()
    }

    @Test
    fun installStreamsTheOutputAndFinishesWithDone() {
        val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        command.gate = gate
        command.before = listOf("Pulling alpine", "Extracting")
        command.after = listOf("Installed")
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest"))

        eventually { ops.operation.value?.lines?.size == 3 }
        val running = ops.operation.value!!
        assertEquals(Kind.Install, running.kind)
        assertEquals("alpine", running.alias)
        assertEquals("alpine:latest", running.displayName)
        assertTrue(running.running)
        assertEquals(listOf("Installing alpine:latest…", "Pulling alpine", "Extracting"), running.lines)

        gate.countDown()
        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(
            listOf("Installing alpine:latest…", "Pulling alpine", "Extracting", "Installed", "Done."),
            done.lines,
        )
        assertEquals(0, done.exitCode)
        assertFalse(done.cancelled)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(listOf("install", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest", "--override-alias", "alpine")),
            command.calls,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun aNonZeroExitEndsWithTheExitCode() {
        command.before = listOf("failed to pull")
        command.exitCode = 3
        val ops = operations()

        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(Kind.Test, done.kind)
        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "failed to pull", "Exit code: 3"), done.lines)
        assertEquals(3, done.exitCode)
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("test", "alpine")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandThatCannotRunEndsWithTheError() {
        command.failure = IOException("Cannot run program \"pr-cli\"")
        val ops = operations()

        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "ERROR: Cannot run program \"pr-cli\""), done.lines)
        assertNull(done.exitCode)
    }

    @Test
    fun aSecondOperationIsRefusedWhileOneRuns() {
        command.gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest"))
        assertFalse(ops.install("ubuntu", "ubuntu:latest", "docker.io/library/ubuntu:latest"))
        assertFalse(ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest"))
        assertFalse(ops.test("ubuntu", "ubuntu:latest"))
        assertFalse(ops.installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", ""))
        assertFalse(ops.installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", "/bad"))

        assertEquals(Kind.Test, ops.operation.value?.kind)
        assertEquals("alpine", ops.operation.value?.alias)
        command.gate!!.countDown()
        ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("test", "alpine")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun dismissIsRefusedWhileRunningAndClearsAFinishedOperation() {
        command.gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        val ops = operations()
        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")

        assertFalse(ops.dismiss())
        assertTrue(ops.operation.value!!.running)

        command.gate!!.countDown()
        ops.awaitFinished()
        assertTrue(ops.dismiss())
        assertNull(ops.operation.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun aNewOperationCanStartOnceTheLastFinished() {
        val ops = operations()
        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")
        ops.awaitFinished()

        assertTrue(ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest"))

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(Kind.Remove, done.kind)
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("test", "alpine"), listOf("remove", "alpine")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun removeWithoutASessionRunsRemove() {
        command.before = listOf("Removed alpine")
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest"))

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(Kind.Remove, done.kind)
        assertEquals(listOf("Removing alpine:latest…", "Removed alpine", "Done."), done.lines)
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("remove", "alpine")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun removeEndsARunningSessionBeforeRemoving() {
        sessions.open("alpine")
        sessions.open("ubuntu")
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest"))

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(
            listOf("Removing alpine:latest…", "Stopping the alpine:latest session…", "Done."),
            done.lines,
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("remove", "alpine")), command.calls)
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("ubuntu")), command.runningAtCall)
        assertTrue(ptys.getValue("alpine").eofSent)
        assertFalse(ptys.getValue("ubuntu").eofSent)
    }

    @Test
    fun removeIsCancelledWhenTheSessionDoesNotStopInTime() {
        endGraceMs = 5_000
        sessions.open("alpine")
        ptys.getValue("alpine").ignoresEof = true
        val ops = operations(endTimeoutMs = 200)

        val started = System.nanoTime()
        assertTrue(ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest"))

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertTrue((System.nanoTime() - started) / 1_000_000 < 3_000)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "Removing alpine:latest…",
                "Stopping the alpine:latest session…",
                "Couldn't stop the alpine:latest session; removal cancelled.",
            ),
            done.lines,
        )
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(listOf("alpine"), sessions.running.value)
        assertTrue(ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest"))
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelDuringARunEndsWithCancelledAndFreesTheRunner() {
        command.gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        command.before = listOf("Running suite distro")
        command.after = listOf("never shown")
        val ops = operations()
        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")
        eventually { ops.operation.value?.lines?.size == 2 }

        ops.cancel()

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "Running suite distro", "Cancelled."), done.lines)
        assertNull(done.exitCode)
        assertTrue(done.cancelled)
        assertTrue(command.sawCancellation)
        command.gate = null
        assertTrue(ops.install("ubuntu", "ubuntu:latest", "docker.io/library/ubuntu:latest"))
        assertEquals("Done.", ops.awaitFinished().lines.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandThatFinishesAsItIsCancelledKeepsItsResult() {
        val gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        command.uninterruptibleGate = gate
        command.after = listOf("All tests passed")
        val ops = operations()
        ops.install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest")
        eventually { command.calls.isNotEmpty() }

        ops.cancel()
        gate.countDown()

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf("Installing alpine:latest…", "All tests passed", "Done."), done.lines)
        assertEquals(0, done.exitCode)
        assertFalse(done.cancelled)
        assertEquals(1, command.calls.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandFailingAsItIsCancelledStillEndsWithCancelled() {
        command.gate = CountDownLatch(1)
        command.failureOnCancel = IOException("Stream closed")
        val ops = operations()
        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")
        eventually { command.calls.isNotEmpty() }

        ops.cancel()

        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "Cancelled."), ops.awaitFinished().lines)
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelDuringRemovesWaitNeverRunsRemove() {
        endGraceMs = 5_000
        sessions.open("alpine")
        ptys.getValue("alpine").ignoresEof = true
        val ops = operations()
        ops.remove("alpine", "alpine:latest")
        eventually { ops.operation.value?.lines?.size == 2 }

        val started = System.nanoTime()
        ops.cancel()

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertTrue((System.nanoTime() - started) / 1_000_000 < 3_000)
        assertEquals(
            listOf("Removing alpine:latest…", "Stopping the alpine:latest session…", "Cancelled."),
            done.lines,
        )
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
        eventually { ptys.getValue("alpine").eofSent }
        Thread.sleep(200)
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun cancelWhenNothingRunsDoesNothing() {
        val ops = operations()
        ops.cancel()
        assertNull(ops.operation.value)

        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")
        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        ops.cancel()

        assertEquals(done, ops.operation.value)
        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "Done."), done.lines)
        assertTrue(ops.dismiss())
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelBeforeTheWorkStartsStillFinishes() {
        val queued = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Runnable>()
        val held = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Executor { queued += it }.asCoroutineDispatcher())
        val ops = DistroOperations(command, sessions, held, { it in installed })
        ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest")

        ops.cancel()
        queued.forEach { it.run() }

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf("Testing alpine:latest…", "Cancelled."), done.lines)
        assertTrue(done.cancelled)
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(ops.test("alpine", "alpine:latest"))
        held.cancel()
    }

    private fun cancelInstall(
        ops: DistroOperations,
        start: DistroOperations.() -> Boolean,
        createdAlias: String?,
        gated: String = "install",
    ) =
        run {
            command.gate = CountDownLatch(1)
            command.gatedCommand = gated
            command.linesFor = mapOf("remove" to listOf("Wiping the rootfs"))
            assertTrue(ops.start())
            eventually { command.calls.isNotEmpty() }
            createdAlias?.let { installed += it }
            ops.cancel()
            ops.awaitFinished()
        }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledInstallOfANewContainerRemovesIt() {
        val ops = operations()

        val done = cancelInstall(ops, { install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest") }, "alpine")

        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                listOf("install", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest", "--override-alias", "alpine"),
                listOf("remove", "alpine"),
            ),
            command.calls,
        )
        assertEquals(listOf("Installing alpine:latest…", "Wiping the rootfs", "Cancelled."), done.lines)
        assertNull(done.exitCode)
        assertTrue(done.cancelled)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledCustomInstallWithAnAliasRemovesIt() {
        val ops = operations()

        cancelInstall(ops, { installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", "deb") }, "deb")

        assertEquals(listOf("remove", "deb"), command.calls.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledInstallOverAContainerThatAlreadyExistedRemovesNothing() {
        installed += "alpine"
        val ops = operations()

        val done = cancelInstall(ops, { install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest") }, null)

        assertEquals(1, command.calls.size)
        assertEquals(listOf("Installing alpine:latest…", "Cancelled."), done.lines)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledInstallThatCreatedNothingRemovesNothing() {
        val ops = operations()

        cancelInstall(ops, { install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest") }, null)

        assertEquals(1, command.calls.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledCustomInstallWithoutAnAliasRemovesNothing() {
        val ops = operations()

        val done = cancelInstall(ops, { installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", "") }, "debian")

        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("install", "docker.io/library/debian:stable")), command.calls)
        assertEquals("Cancelled.", done.lines.last())
    }

    @Test
    fun aCancelledTestRemovesNothing() {
        val ops = operations()

        cancelInstall(ops, { test("alpine", "alpine:latest") }, "alpine", gated = "test")

        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("test", "alpine")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun customInstallWithAnAliasOverridesIt() {
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.installCustom("  docker.io/library/debian:stable ", " debian-custom "))

        val done = ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(Kind.Install, done.kind)
        assertEquals("docker.io/library/debian:stable", done.displayName)
        assertTrue(done.custom)
        assertEquals(listOf("Installing docker.io/library/debian:stable…", "Done."), done.lines)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(listOf("install", "docker.io/library/debian:stable", "--override-alias", "debian-custom")),
            command.calls,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun customInstallWithoutAnAliasPassesOnlyTheSource() {
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", "  "))

        ops.awaitFinished()
        assertEquals(listOf(listOf("install", "docker.io/library/debian:stable")), command.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun customInstallWithABlankSourceIsIgnored() {
        val ops = operations()

        assertFalse(ops.installCustom("   ", "debian-custom"))

        assertNull(ops.operation.value)
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun anInvalidCustomAliasShowsTheErrorWithoutRunning() {
        val ops = operations()

        assertTrue(ops.installCustom("docker.io/library/debian:stable", "../etc"))

        val done = ops.operation.value!!
        assertFalse(done.running)
        assertTrue(done.custom)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "ERROR: Invalid alias '../etc'.",
                "Alias must start with an alphanumeric character and use only [A-Za-z0-9_.+-].",
            ),
            done.lines,
        )
        assertTrue(command.calls.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun catalogInstallsAreNotCustom() {
        val ops = operations()
        ops.install("alpine", "alpine:latest", "docker.io/library/alpine:latest")
        assertFalse(ops.awaitFinished().custom)
    }

    @Test
    fun overrideAliasRulesAreUnchanged() {
        listOf("debian-custom", "a", "Alpine_3.20+x", "9lives").forEach {
            assertTrue(it, DistroOperations.isValidOverrideAlias(it))
        }
        listOf("", "-x", ".x", "a/b", "a\\b", "a..b", "setup.sh", "a b", "a:b").forEach {
            assertFalse(it, DistroOperations.isValidOverrideAlias(it))
        }
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

class InstalledContainersTest {

    @get:Rule
    val prefix = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun dir(path: String) = File(prefix.root, path).apply { mkdirs() }

    @Test
    fun aContainerIsInstalledOnceItsRootfsOrLegacyDirectoryExists() {
        dir("var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/debian")
        dir("var/lib/pr/containers/alpine/rootfs")
        dir("var/lib/pr/containers/pulling")
        File(prefix.root, "var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs/notes.txt").writeText("")
        val containers = InstalledContainers(prefix.root)

        assertEquals(setOf("debian", "alpine"), containers.aliases())
        assertTrue(containers.contains("debian"))
        assertTrue(containers.contains("alpine"))
        assertFalse(containers.contains("pulling"))
        assertFalse(containers.contains("notes.txt"))
        assertFalse(containers.contains("ubuntu"))
        assertFalse(containers.contains(""))
    }

    @Test
    fun nothingIsInstalledOnAFreshPrefix() {
        val containers = InstalledContainers(prefix.root)
        assertEquals(emptySet<String>(), containers.aliases())
        assertFalse(containers.contains("alpine"))
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.system.Os
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PtyNativeContractTest {

    private fun readUntil(fd: Int, done: (String) -> Boolean): String {
        val buf = ByteArray(1024)
        val out = StringBuilder()
        val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 10_000
        while (!done(out.toString()) && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
            val n = PtyNative.read(fd, buf, 0, buf.size)
            if (n < 0) break
            out.append(String(buf, 0, n))
        }
        return out.toString()
    }

    @Test
    fun waitPidTellsRunningFromExited() {
        val (masterFd, pid) = PtyNative.forkPtyWithPid(
            "/system/bin/sh", arrayOf("sh", "-c", "sleep 1; exit 3"), null, 24, 80)
        assertTrue("forkPty failed", masterFd >= 0 && pid > 0)
        try {
            assertEquals(PtyNative.STILL_RUNNING, PtyNative.waitPid(pid))
            var status = PtyNative.STILL_RUNNING
            val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 10_000
            while (status == PtyNative.STILL_RUNNING && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(50)
                status = PtyNative.waitPid(pid)
            }
            assertEquals(3, status)
        } finally {
            PtyNative.close(masterFd)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun childGetsArgsAndEnvOnTopOfInheritedEnv() {
        val masterFd = PtyNative.forkPty(
            "/system/bin/sh",
            arrayOf("sh", "-c", "echo \"<\$PIT_FOO|\$0|\${PATH:+path}>\"", "zero"),
            arrayOf("PIT_FOO", "first", "PIT_FOO", "bar"),
            24, 80)
        assertTrue("forkPty failed", masterFd >= 0)
        try {
            val out = readUntil(masterFd) { it.contains(">") }
            assertTrue("unexpected child output: $out", out.contains("<bar|zero|path>"))
        } finally {
            PtyNative.close(masterFd)
        }
    }

    private fun childOutput(script: String, forkOnMainThread: Boolean = false): String {
        val args = arrayOf("sh", "-c", "$script; echo END")
        var masterFd = -1
        if (forkOnMainThread) {
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
                masterFd = PtyNative.forkPty("/system/bin/sh", args, null, 24, 80)
            }
        } else {
            masterFd = PtyNative.forkPty("/system/bin/sh", args, null, 24, 80)
        }
        assertTrue("forkPty failed", masterFd >= 0)
        try {
            return readUntil(masterFd) { it.contains("END") }
        } finally {
            PtyNative.close(masterFd)
        }
    }

    private fun signalMask(out: String, field: String): Long =
        Regex("$field:\\s*([0-9a-f]+)").find(out)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toLong(16)
            ?: throw AssertionError("no $field in: $out")

    @Test
    fun childHasOnlyTheTerminalDescriptors() {
        val (readEnd, writeEnd) = ParcelFileDescriptor.createPipe()
        val inheritable = Os.dup(readEnd.fileDescriptor)
        try {
            val out = childOutput("sleep 5 & ls -1 /proc/\$!/fd; kill \$!")
            val fds = out.lines().map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() && it.all(Char::isDigit) }
            assertEquals("child descriptors: $out", listOf("0", "1", "2"), fds)
        } finally {
            Os.close(inheritable)
            readEnd.close()
            writeEnd.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun childStartsWithNoBlockedOrIgnoredSignals() {
        val bionicPosixTimerSignal = 1L shl (32 - 1)
        val bionicArtProfilerSignal = 1L shl (38 - 1)
        val out = childOutput("grep -E '^Sig(Blk|Ign)' /proc/self/status", forkOnMainThread = true)
        assertEquals("blocked: $out", 0L, signalMask(out, "SigBlk") and bionicPosixTimerSignal.inv())
        assertEquals("ignored: $out", 0L, signalMask(out, "SigIgn") and bionicArtProfilerSignal.inv())
    }

    @Test
    fun writeRejectsSliceOutsideTheArray() {
        val (readEnd, writeEnd) = ParcelFileDescriptor.createPipe()
        try {
            assertThrows(ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException::class.java) {
                PtyNative.write(writeEnd.fd, ByteArray(4), 2, 8)
            }
            assertThrows(ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException::class.java) {
                PtyNative.write(writeEnd.fd, ByteArray(4), -1, 2)
            }
        } finally {
            readEnd.close()
            writeEnd.close()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun readRejectsSliceOutsideTheArrayWithoutConsumingInput() {
        val (readEnd, writeEnd) = ParcelFileDescriptor.createPipe()
        try {
            val data = "0123456789abcdef".toByteArray()
            assertEquals(data.size, PtyNative.write(writeEnd.fd, data, 0, data.size))
            assertThrows(ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException::class.java) {
                PtyNative.read(readEnd.fd, ByteArray(4), 2, 8)
            }
            val buf = ByteArray(32)
            val n = PtyNative.read(readEnd.fd, buf, 0, buf.size)
            assertEquals("0123456789abcdef", String(buf, 0, n))
        } finally {
            readEnd.close()
            writeEnd.close()
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/proot-engine/src/androidTest/java/id/or/oo/pr/engine/PtyNativeTest.kt

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PtyNativeTest {

    @Test
    fun testPtyNativeForkAndRead() {
        val args = arrayOf("/system/bin/echo", "hello pty")
        val envVars = emptyArray<String>()
        val masterFd = PtyNative.forkPty(args[0], args, envVars, 24, 80)
        
        assertTrue("masterFd should be > 0, got $masterFd", masterFd > 0)
        
        val buf = ByteArray(1024)
        // Note: PTY reads can sometimes return early with carriage returns etc., 
        // so we do a simple read which should be enough for 'echo'.
        val n = PtyNative.read(masterFd, buf, 0, buf.size)
        assertTrue("Should read some bytes, got $n", n > 0)
        
        val output = String(buf, 0, n)
        assertTrue("Output should contain our echoed text, got '$output'", output.contains("hello pty"))
        
        val pid = PtyNative.getPid()
        assertTrue("PID should be > 0, got $pid", pid > 0)
        
        // Wait for child to exit. The echo command exits almost instantly.
        var exitStatus = PtyNative.waitPid(pid)
        // If it hasn't exited yet, wait a tiny bit and retry (simple busy-wait for test)
        var retries = 50
        while (exitStatus == PtyNative.STILL_RUNNING && retries > 0) {
            Thread.sleep(10)
            exitStatus = PtyNative.waitPid(pid)
            retries--
        }
        assertEquals("Echo should exit with 0", 0, exitStatus)
        
        PtyNative.close(masterFd)
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/proot-engine/src/androidTest/java/id/or/oo/pr/engine/SessionReapTest.kt

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File

/** A session's child must be reaped as soon as it exits, not left as a zombie until the app dies. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SessionReapTest {

    @Test
    fun exitedSessionChildIsReaped() {
        val (masterFd, pid) = PtyNative.forkPtyWithPid(
            "/system/bin/sh", arrayOf("sh", "-c", "exit 3"), null, 24, 80)
        assertTrue("forkPty failed", masterFd >= 0 && pid > 0)
        val session = ProotLauncher.Session(masterFd, pid)

        val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 10_000
        while (session.exitCode == null && System.currentTimeMillis() < deadline) {
            Thread.sleep(50)
        }
        session.close()

        assertEquals(3, session.exitCode)
        assertFalse("pid $pid is still a zombie", File("/proc/$pid").exists())
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/proot-engine/src/main/cpp/ptyjni.c
----------------------------------------------------------------------
#include <jni.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <android/log.h>

#define UNUSED __attribute__((unused))
#define TAG "PTY"
#define STILL_RUNNING (-2)
#define LOGI(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_INFO, TAG, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGE(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_ERROR, TAG, __VA_ARGS__)

static int open_ptm(void) {
    int fd = open("/dev/ptmx", O_RDWR | O_NOCTTY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        LOGE("open /dev/ptmx: %s", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    return fd;
}

static int setup_slave(int ptm_fd) {
    if (grantpt(ptm_fd) < 0) {
        LOGE("grantpt: %s", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    if (unlockpt(ptm_fd) < 0) {
        LOGE("unlockpt: %s", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}

static pid_t last_child_pid = -1;

extern char **environ;

static void free_strings(char **strings) {
    if (!strings) return;
    for (char **p = strings; *p; p++) free(*p);
    free(strings);
}

static char *dup_jstring(JNIEnv *env, jstring js) {
    if (!js) return NULL;
    const char *utf = (*env)->GetStringUTFChars(env, js, NULL);
    if (!utf) return NULL;
    char *copy = strdup(utf);
    (*env)->ReleaseStringUTFChars(env, js, utf);
    return copy;
}

static char *dup_array_element(JNIEnv *env, jobjectArray array, jsize i) {
    jstring js = (jstring) (*env)->GetObjectArrayElement(env, array, i);
    char *copy = dup_jstring(env, js);
    (*env)->DeleteLocalRef(env, js);
    return copy;
}

static char **build_argv(JNIEnv *env, const char *cmd, jobjectArray jArgs) {
    jsize argc = jArgs ? (*env)->GetArrayLength(env, jArgs) : 0;
    char **argv = calloc((size_t) (argc > 0 ? argc : 1) + 1, sizeof(char *));
    if (!argv) return NULL;
    if (argc == 0) {
        argv[0] = strdup(cmd);
        if (!argv[0]) {
            free(argv);
            return NULL;
        }
        return argv;
    }
    for (jsize i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
        argv[i] = dup_array_element(env, jArgs, i);
        if (!argv[i]) {
            free_strings(argv);
            return NULL;
        }
    }
    return argv;
}

static size_t name_length(const char *entry) {
    const char *eq = strchr(entry, '=');
    return eq ? (size_t) (eq - entry) : strlen(entry);
}

static bool same_name(const char *a, const char *b) {
    size_t n = name_length(a);
    return n == name_length(b) && strncmp(a, b, n) == 0;
}

static bool overridden(char **overrides, size_t from, const char *entry) {
    for (size_t i = from; overrides[i]; i++)
        if (same_name(overrides[i], entry)) return true;
    return false;
}

static char **build_envp(JNIEnv *env, jobjectArray jEnvVars) {
    jsize pairs = jEnvVars ? (*env)->GetArrayLength(env, jEnvVars) / 2 : 0;
    char **overrides = calloc((size_t) pairs + 1, sizeof(char *));
    if (!overrides) return NULL;
    for (jsize i = 0; i < pairs; i++) {
        char *key = dup_array_element(env, jEnvVars, 2 * i);
        char *val = dup_array_element(env, jEnvVars, 2 * i + 1);
        if (!key || !val || asprintf(&overrides[i], "%s=%s", key, val) < 0) {
            overrides[i] = NULL;
            free(key);
            free(val);
            free_strings(overrides);
            return NULL;
        }
        free(key);
        free(val);
    }

    size_t inherited = 0;
    while (environ && environ[inherited]) inherited++;
    char **envp = calloc(inherited + (size_t) pairs + 1, sizeof(char *));
    if (!envp) {
        free_strings(overrides);
        return NULL;
    }
    size_t n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < inherited; i++) {
        if (overridden(overrides, 0, environ[i])) continue;
        envp[n] = strdup(environ[i]);
        if (!envp[n]) goto fail;
        n++;
    }
    for (jsize i = 0; i < pairs; i++) {
        if (overridden(overrides, (size_t) i + 1, overrides[i])) continue;
        envp[n] = strdup(overrides[i]);
        if (!envp[n]) goto fail;
        n++;
    }
    free_strings(overrides);
    return envp;

fail:
    free_strings(overrides);
    free_strings(envp);
    return NULL;
}

static void write_str(const char *s) {
    (void) write(STDERR_FILENO, s, strlen(s));
}

static void reset_signals(void) {
    sigset_t none;
    sigemptyset(&none);
    sigprocmask(SIG_SETMASK, &none, NULL);
    for (int sig = 1; sig < NSIG; sig++)
        if (sig != SIGKILL && sig != SIGSTOP) signal(sig, SIG_DFL);
}

static void close_inherited_fds(void) {
    if (syscall(SYS_close_range, 3, ~0U, 0) == 0) return;
    for (int fd = 3; fd < 65536; fd++) close(fd);
}

static void exec_child(const char *pts_name, const char *cmd, char **argv, char **envp) {
    reset_signals();
    setsid();
    int pts_fd = open(pts_name, O_RDWR);
    if (pts_fd < 0) _exit(127);
    dup2(pts_fd, STDIN_FILENO);
    dup2(pts_fd, STDOUT_FILENO);
    dup2(pts_fd, STDERR_FILENO);
    close_inherited_fds();

    execve(cmd, argv, envp);

    int err = errno;
    char digits[12];
    int i = sizeof(digits);
    digits[--i] = '\0';
    do {
        digits[--i] = (char) ('0' + err % 10);
        err /= 10;
    } while (err > 0 && i > 0);
    write_str("execve failed for '");
    write_str(cmd);
    write_str("' (errno ");
    write_str(&digits[i]);
    write_str(")\n");
    _exit(127);
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeForkPty(
    JNIEnv *env, jclass cls UNUSED, jstring jCmd, jobjectArray jArgs, jobjectArray jEnvVars,
    jint rows, jint cols) {

    char *cmd = dup_jstring(env, jCmd);
    char **argv = cmd ? build_argv(env, cmd, jArgs) : NULL;
    char **envp = argv ? build_envp(env, jEnvVars) : NULL;
    if (!envp) {
        LOGE("forkPty: could not copy the command, arguments or environment");
        goto fail;
    }

    int ptm_fd = open_ptm();
    if (ptm_fd < 0) goto fail;

    if (setup_slave(ptm_fd) < 0) {
        close(ptm_fd);
        goto fail;
    }

    struct winsize ws;
    memset(&ws, 0, sizeof(ws));
    ws.ws_row = (unsigned short) rows;
    ws.ws_col = (unsigned short) cols;
    ioctl(ptm_fd, TIOCSWINSZ, &ws);

    char pts_name[64];
    int err = ptsname_r(ptm_fd, pts_name, sizeof(pts_name));
    if (err != 0) {
        LOGE("ptsname_r: %s", strerror(err));
        close(ptm_fd);
        goto fail;
    }

    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid < 0) {
        LOGE("fork: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(ptm_fd);
        goto fail;
    }

    if (pid == 0) {
        close(ptm_fd);
        exec_child(pts_name, cmd, argv, envp);
    }

    free(cmd);
    free_strings(argv);
    free_strings(envp);
    last_child_pid = pid;
    return ptm_fd;

fail:
    free(cmd);
    free_strings(argv);
    free_strings(envp);
    return -1;
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeGetPid(JNIEnv *env UNUSED, jclass cls UNUSED) {
    return (jint) last_child_pid;
}

static bool slice_in_bounds(JNIEnv *env, jbyteArray jBuf, jint offset, jint length) {
    jsize size = (*env)->GetArrayLength(env, jBuf);
    if (offset < 0 || length < 0 || offset > size - length) {
        jclass cls = (*env)->FindClass(env, "java/lang/ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException");
        if (cls) (*env)->ThrowNew(env, cls, "offset/length outside the array");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeRead(
    JNIEnv *env, jclass cls UNUSED, jint fd, jbyteArray jBuf, jint offset, jint length) {

    if (!slice_in_bounds(env, jBuf, offset, length)) return -1;
    jbyte *buf = (*env)->GetByteArrayElements(env, jBuf, NULL);
    if (!buf) return -1;
    ssize_t n = read(fd, buf + offset, (size_t) length);
    (*env)->ReleaseByteArrayElements(env, jBuf, buf, 0);

    if (n < 0) {
        if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EINTR) return 0;
        return -1;
    }
    return (jint) n;
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeWrite(
    JNIEnv *env, jclass cls UNUSED, jint fd, jbyteArray jBuf, jint offset, jint length) {

    if (!slice_in_bounds(env, jBuf, offset, length)) return -1;
    jbyte *buf = (*env)->GetByteArrayElements(env, jBuf, NULL);
    if (!buf) return -1;
    ssize_t n = write(fd, buf + offset, (size_t) length);
    (*env)->ReleaseByteArrayElements(env, jBuf, buf, JNI_ABORT);

    if (n < 0) {
        if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EINTR) return 0;
        return -1;
    }
    return (jint) n;
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeResize(
    JNIEnv *env UNUSED, jclass cls UNUSED, jint fd, jint rows, jint cols) {

    struct winsize ws;
    memset(&ws, 0, sizeof(ws));
    ws.ws_row = (unsigned short) rows;
    ws.ws_col = (unsigned short) cols;
    return ioctl(fd, TIOCSWINSZ, &ws);
}

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeWaitPid(JNIEnv *env UNUSED, jclass cls UNUSED, jint pid) {
    int status;
    pid_t result = waitpid(pid, &status, WNOHANG);
    if (result < 0) return -1;
    if (result == 0) return STILL_RUNNING;
    if (WIFEXITED(status)) return WEXITSTATUS(status);
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status)) return 128 + WTERMSIG(status);
    return -1;
}

/* Block until @pid exits and reap it: exit code, or 128 + signal; -1 on error. */
JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeWaitPidBlocking(JNIEnv *env UNUSED, jclass cls UNUSED, jint pid) {
    int status;
    pid_t result;
    do {
        result = waitpid(pid, &status, 0);
    } while (result < 0 && errno == EINTR);
    if (result < 0) return -1;
    if (WIFEXITED(status)) return WEXITSTATUS(status);
    if (WIFSIGNALED(status)) return 128 + WTERMSIG(status);
    return -1;
}

JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_id_or_oo_pr_engine_PtyNative_nativeClose(JNIEnv *env UNUSED, jclass cls UNUSED, jint fd) {
    close(fd);
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/proot-engine/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/engine/NetworkDns.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import java.net.Inet6Address
import java.net.InetAddress

object NetworkDns {
    /**
     * The network's DNS servers the container can actually reach. IPv6 servers are dropped when the
     * network has no IPv6 default route (seen on mobile data); glibc would otherwise wait out its
     * resolver timeout on them before every lookup reaches the public fallback.
     */
    fun usableServers(servers: List<InetAddress>, hasIpv6DefaultRoute: Boolean): List<String> =
        servers.filter { hasIpv6DefaultRoute || it !is Inet6Address }.mapNotNull { it.hostAddress }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import android.util.Log
import java.io.File
import kotlin.concurrent.thread

class ProotLauncher(private val host: ProotHost) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PR"
    }

    val prefixDir: File
        get() = host.prefixDir

    fun startSession(
        distroName: String,
        user: String = "root",
        isolated: Boolean = false,
        rows: Int = 50,
        cols: Int = 200
    ): Session? {
        val prCli = File(prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli")
        if (!prCli.exists()) {
            Log.e(TAG, "pr-cli not found at $prCli")
            return null
        }

        val envVars = buildEnvVars()
        val args = arrayOf(prCli.absolutePath, "login", distroName, "--user", user)

        val (masterFd, pid) = PtyNative.forkPtyWithPid(args[0], args, envVars, rows, cols)
        if (masterFd < 0) {
            Log.e(TAG, "forkPty failed with fd=$masterFd")
            return null
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "PTY session started for $distroName, masterFd=$masterFd")
        return Session(masterFd, pid)
    }

    /**
     * Start a PTY session with a pre-parsed argument list.
     * Use this instead of [runCommand] when arguments contain spaces or quotes
     * that would be mangled by naive string splitting.
     */
    fun startCustomSession(
        args: List<String>,
        rows: Int = 24,
        cols: Int = 80,
    ): Session? {
        val envVars = buildEnvVars()
        val (masterFd, pid) = PtyNative.forkPtyWithPid(args[0], args.toTypedArray(), envVars, rows, cols)
        if (masterFd < 0) {
            Log.e(TAG, "forkPty failed with fd=$masterFd for ${args.joinToString(" ")}")
            return null
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "PTY custom session started: ${args.joinToString(" ")}, masterFd=$masterFd")
        return Session(masterFd, pid)
    }

    fun runCommand(
        command: String,
        rows: Int = 24,
        cols: Int = 80,
    ): Session? {
        val prCli = File(prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli")
        val envVars = buildEnvVars()
        val args = arrayOf(prCli.absolutePath, *command.split(" ").toTypedArray())

        val (masterFd, pid) = PtyNative.forkPtyWithPid(args[0], args, envVars, rows, cols)
        if (masterFd < 0) {
            Log.e(TAG, "forkPty failed for command: $command")
            return null
        }

        Log.i(TAG, "PTY command started: $command, masterFd=$masterFd")
        return Session(masterFd, pid)
    }

    private fun buildEnvVars(): Array<String> {
        val binDir = File(prefixDir, "bin")
        val homeDir = host.homeDir
        val prefix = prefixDir.absolutePath

        return arrayOf(
            "APP_PREFIX", prefix,
            "APP_HOME", homeDir.absolutePath,
            "APP_PACKAGE", host.packageName,
            "PATH", "${binDir.absolutePath}:/system/bin:/system/xbin",
            "HOME", homeDir.absolutePath,
            "PROOT_NO_SECCOMP", "1",
            "PROOT_TMP_DIR", host.cacheDir.absolutePath,
            "TERM", "xterm-256color",
            "LANG", "en_US.UTF-8",
            "TMPDIR", host.cacheDir.absolutePath,
            "APP_DNS_SERVERS", host.dnsServers.joinToString(","),
        )
    }

    class Session(val masterFd: Int, val pid: Int = -1) {
        var closed = false
            private set

        /** Child exit code (128 + signal if killed), set once the child has been reaped. */
        @Volatile
        var exitCode: Int? = null
            private set

        init {
            // Reap the child as soon as it exits, however the session ends; without a waiter it
            // stays a zombie until the app process dies.
            if (pid > 0) {
                thread(isDaemon = true, name = "pty-reaper-$pid") {
                    exitCode = PtyNative.waitPidBlocking(pid)
                }
            }
        }

        fun read(buf: ByteArray, offset: Int = 0, length: Int = buf.size): Int {
            if (closed) return -1
            return PtyNative.read(masterFd, buf, offset, length)
        }

        fun write(data: ByteArray): Int {
            if (closed) return -1
            return PtyNative.write(masterFd, data, 0, data.size)
        }

        fun resize(rows: Int, cols: Int): Int {
            if (closed) return -1
            return PtyNative.resize(masterFd, rows, cols)
        }

        fun close() {
            if (!closed) {
                closed = true
                try {
                    PtyNative.write(masterFd, byteArrayOf(0x04), 0, 1)
                } catch (_: Exception) {}
                try {
                    PtyNative.close(masterFd)
                } catch (_: Exception) {}
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/proot-engine/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/engine/PtyNative.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.engine

object PtyNative {
    /** [waitPid] result while the child has not exited yet. */
    const val STILL_RUNNING = -2

    init {
        System.loadLibrary("ptyjni")
    }

    // Synchronized with forkPtyWithPid, which reads the pid this call records natively.
    @Synchronized
    fun forkPty(cmd: String, args: Array<String>?, envVars: Array<String>?, rows: Int, cols: Int): Int {
        return nativeForkPty(cmd, args, envVars, rows, cols)
    }

    /** Fork like [forkPty] and return (masterFd, childPid); the pid is read under the same lock. */
    @Synchronized
    fun forkPtyWithPid(cmd: String, args: Array<String>?, envVars: Array<String>?, rows: Int, cols: Int): Pair<Int, Int> {
        val fd = nativeForkPty(cmd, args, envVars, rows, cols)
        return fd to (if (fd >= 0) nativeGetPid() else -1)
    }

    /** Block until [pid] exits and reap it; exit code, or 128 + signal. */
    fun waitPidBlocking(pid: Int): Int {
        return nativeWaitPidBlocking(pid)
    }

    fun read(fd: Int, buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int {
        return nativeRead(fd, buf, offset, length)
    }

    fun write(fd: Int, buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int {
        return nativeWrite(fd, buf, offset, length)
    }

    fun resize(fd: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int): Int {
        return nativeResize(fd, rows, cols)
    }

    /** Reap [pid] if it has exited: exit code, or 128 + signal; [STILL_RUNNING]; -1 on error. */
    fun waitPid(pid: Int): Int {
        return nativeWaitPid(pid)
    }

    fun close(fd: Int) {
        nativeClose(fd)
    }

    fun getPid(): Int {
        return nativeGetPid()
    }

    private external fun nativeForkPty(cmd: String, args: Array<String>?, envVars: Array<String>?, rows: Int, cols: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeRead(fd: Int, buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeWrite(fd: Int, buf: ByteArray, offset: Int, length: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeResize(fd: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeWaitPid(pid: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeWaitPidBlocking(pid: Int): Int
    private external fun nativeClose(fd: Int)
    private external fun nativeGetPid(): Int
}

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test
import java.net.InetAddress

class NetworkDnsTest {

    private val v4 = InetAddress.getByName("192.168.100.1")
    private val v6 = InetAddress.getByName("2400:9800:2:2::245")

    @Test
    fun ipv6ServersAreDroppedWithoutAnIpv6DefaultRoute() {
        assertEquals(listOf("192.168.100.1"), NetworkDns.usableServers(listOf(v6, v4), hasIpv6DefaultRoute = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun ipv6ServersAreKeptWithAnIpv6DefaultRoute() {
        assertEquals(listOf(v6.hostAddress, "192.168.100.1"),
            NetworkDns.usableServers(listOf(v6, v4), hasIpv6DefaultRoute = true))
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.engine

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.lang.reflect.Method

class ProotLauncherTest {

    private val fakeHost = object : ProotHost {
        override val prefixDir = File("/fake/prefix")
        override val homeDir = File("/fake/home")
        override val packageName = "id.or.oo.test"
        override val cacheDir = File("/fake/cache")
    }

    @Test
    fun testBuildEnvVars() {
        val launcher = ProotLauncher(fakeHost)
        
        // buildEnvVars is private, we can use reflection for this quick win test
        val method: Method = ProotLauncher::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("buildEnvVars")
        method.isAccessible = true
        val envVars = method.invoke(launcher) as Array<String>
        
        // Convert to map for easier assertions
        val envMap = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
        for (i in envVars.indices step 2) {
            envMap[envVars[i]] = envVars[i + 1]
        }
        
        assertEquals("/fake/prefix", envMap["APP_PREFIX"])
        assertEquals("/fake/home", envMap["APP_HOME"])
        assertEquals("id.or.oo.test", envMap["APP_PACKAGE"])
        assertEquals("/fake/prefix/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin", envMap["PATH"])
        assertEquals("/fake/home", envMap["HOME"])
        assertEquals("1", envMap["PROOT_NO_SECCOMP"])
        assertEquals("/fake/cache", envMap["PROOT_TMP_DIR"])
        assertEquals("/fake/cache", envMap["TMPDIR"])
        assertEquals("xterm-256color", envMap["TERM"])
        assertEquals("en_US.UTF-8", envMap["LANG"])
    }

    @Test
    fun testBuildEnvVarsPassesNetworkDnsServers() {
        val host = object : ProotHost by fakeHost {
            override val dnsServers = listOf("192.168.1.1", "2400:9800:2:2::245")
        }
        val method: Method = ProotLauncher::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("buildEnvVars")
        method.isAccessible = true
        val envVars = method.invoke(ProotLauncher(host)) as Array<String>
        val envMap = envVars.toList().chunked(2).associate { it[0] to it[1] }

        assertEquals("192.168.1.1,2400:9800:2:2::245", envMap["APP_DNS_SERVERS"])
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.PowerManager
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class ServiceForegroundController(private val context: Context) : SessionManager.ForegroundController {
    override fun start() {
        context.startForegroundService(Intent(context, SessionService::class.java))
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("SessionService is not declared in the app manifest")
    }
}

class NotificationEndedNotifier(private val context: Context) : SessionManager.EndedNotifier {
    override fun sessionEnded(alias: String, exitCode: Int?) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 &&
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) !=
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) return
        SessionNotifications.createChannels(context)
        NotificationManagerCompat.from(context)
            .notify("ended:$alias".hashCode(), SessionNotifications.ended(context, alias, exitCode))
    }
}

fun Context.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(): Boolean =
    getSystemService(PowerManager::class.java).isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(packageName)

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.util.Log
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotLauncher
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class CommandSessionFactory internal constructor(
    private val host: ProotHost,
    private val container: String,
    private val command: String,
    private val sink: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit,
    private val binds: List<Bind>,
    private val startSession: (List<String>) -> ProotLauncher.Session?,
    private val processes: ProotProcesses = ProotProcesses(),
    private val pty: (ProotLauncher.Session, ProotProcesses) -> Pty = ::commandPty,
    internal val signalWaitMs: Long = ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS,
) : SessionManager.SessionFactory {

    @JvmOverloads
    constructor(
        host: ProotHost,
        container: String,
        command: String,
        sink: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit,
        binds: List<Bind> = emptyList(),
        signalWaitMs: Long = ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS,
    ) : this(host, container, command, sink, binds, ProotLauncher(host)::startCustomSession, signalWaitMs = signalWaitMs)

    init {
        require(command.isNotBlank()) { "command must not be blank" }
        require(signalWaitMs in 1..TimeUnit.HOURS.toMillis(1)) { "signalWaitMs must be between 1 and 3600000: $signalWaitMs" }
    }

    override fun create(alias: String, onEnded: (ManagedSession) -> Unit): ManagedSession =
        ManagedSession(
            alias = alias,
            pty = startPty(alias),
            emulator = null,
            output = isolated(alias),
            onEnded = onEnded,
            signalWaitMs = signalWaitMs,
        )

    internal fun startPty(alias: String): Pty {
        val prCli = File(host.prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli")
        check(prCli.exists()) { "could not start a command session for $alias: no pr-cli at $prCli" }
        binds.forEach { bind ->
            check(File(bind.hostPath).exists()) { "could not start a command session for $alias: no bind source ${bind.hostPath}" }
        }
        val session = startSession(loginArgs(host.prefixDir, container, command, binds))
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("could not start a command session for $alias")
        return pty(session, processes)
    }

    private fun isolated(alias: String): (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit {
        var logged = false
        return { buf, off, len ->
            try {
                sink(buf, off, len)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (!logged) Log.w(TAG, "the output sink of $alias failed; its output is dropped while it fails", e)
                logged = true
            }
        }
    }

    internal companion object {
        val END_POLICY = EndPolicy.SIGNAL_EVERY_TRACEE
        private const val TAG = "PR"
    }
}

internal fun commandPty(session: ProotLauncher.Session, processes: ProotProcesses = ProotProcesses()): Pty =
    ProotPty(session, processes, CommandSessionFactory.END_POLICY)

internal fun loginArgs(prefixDir: File, container: String, command: String, binds: List<Bind>): List<String> =
    terminalArgs(prefixDir, container, binds) + listOf("--", command)

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ManagedSession.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import org.connectbot.terminal.TerminalEmulator
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import kotlin.concurrent.thread

class ManagedSession(
    val alias: String,
    private val pty: Pty,
    val emulator: TerminalEmulator?,
    private val output: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit,
    private val onEnded: (ManagedSession) -> Unit,
    private val endGraceMs: Long = END_GRACE_MS,
    private val signalWaitMs: Long = SIGNAL_WAIT_MS,
    private val exitCodeWaitMs: Long = EXIT_CODE_WAIT_MS,
    private val killExitWaitMs: Long = KILL_EXIT_WAIT_MS,
) {
    fun interface Screen {
        fun close()
    }

    data class Exit(val code: Int?)

    private val _exit = MutableStateFlow<Exit?>(null)
    val exit: StateFlow<Exit?> = _exit

    private val endFlag = AtomicBoolean(false)
    val endRequested: Boolean
        get() = endFlag.get()

    @Volatile
    internal var onEndRequested: () -> Unit = {}

    private val ptyLock = Any()
    private var closed = false
    private val ended = CountDownLatch(1)
    private val screenLock = Any()
    private var screen: Screen? = null
    private var visible = false

    val hasScreen: Boolean
        get() = synchronized(screenLock) { screen != null }

    val screenVisible: Boolean
        get() = synchronized(screenLock) { screen != null && visible }

    fun setVisible(screen: Screen, visible: Boolean) {
        synchronized(screenLock) {
            if (this.screen === screen) this.visible = visible
        }
    }

    fun start() {
        thread(isDaemon = true, name = "pty-reader-$alias") { readLoop() }
    }

    fun write(data: ByteArray) {
        synchronized(ptyLock) { if (!closed) pty.write(data) }
    }

    fun resize(rows: Int, cols: Int) {
        synchronized(ptyLock) { if (!closed) pty.resize(rows, cols) }
    }

    fun attach(screen: Screen): Screen? = synchronized(screenLock) {
        val previous = this.screen
        this.screen = screen
        visible = true
        previous?.takeIf { it !== screen }
    }

    fun detach(screen: Screen) {
        synchronized(screenLock) {
            if (this.screen === screen) this.screen = null
        }
    }

    fun end() {
        if (_exit.value != null) return
        if (!endFlag.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        onEndRequested()
        thread(isDaemon = true, name = "pty-end-$alias") {
            val signalled = pty.signalTracees()
            if (signalled.isNotEmpty() && awaitEndOrExit(signalled)) return@thread
            thread(isDaemon = true, name = "pty-eof-$alias") { synchronized(ptyLock) { if (!closed) pty.sendEof() } }
            if (ended.await(endGraceMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) return@thread
            pty.kill()
            if (ended.await(endGraceMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) return@thread
            pty.forceKill()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitEndOrExit(pids: Set<Int>): Boolean {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(signalWaitMs)
        while (true) {
            val left = deadline - System.nanoTime()
            if (left <= 0) return false
            if (ended.await(minOf(left, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(POLL_MS)), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS)) return true
            if (!pty.alive(pids)) return ended.count == 0L
        }
    }

    private fun readLoop() {
        val buf = ByteArray(8192)
        try {
            while (true) {
                val n = pty.read(buf)
                if (n < 0) break
                if (n > 0) output(buf, 0, n)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
        } finally {
            finish()
        }
    }

    private fun awaitExitCode(ms: Long): Boolean {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(ms)
        while (pty.exitCode == null && deadline - System.nanoTime() > 0) Thread.sleep(20)
        return pty.exitCode != null
    }

    private fun finish() {
        runCatching {
            if (!awaitExitCode(exitCodeWaitMs)) {
                pty.kill()
                if (!awaitExitCode(killExitWaitMs)) pty.forceKill()
            }
        }
        synchronized(ptyLock) {
            closed = true
            runCatching { pty.close() }
        }
        _exit.value = Exit(pty.exitCode)
        ended.countDown()
        onEnded(this)
    }

    companion object {
        const val END_GRACE_MS = 2_000L
        const val SIGNAL_WAIT_MS = 10_000L
        const val EXIT_CODE_WAIT_MS = 2_000L
        const val KILL_EXIT_WAIT_MS = 500L
        private const val POLL_MS = 50L
        internal const val SCAN_MARGIN_MS = 1_000L
        internal const val TIMEOUT_HEADROOM_MS = 2_500L

        fun endWorstCaseMs(
            signalWaitMs: Long = SIGNAL_WAIT_MS,
            endGraceMs: Long = END_GRACE_MS,
            exitCodeWaitMs: Long = EXIT_CODE_WAIT_MS,
            killExitWaitMs: Long = KILL_EXIT_WAIT_MS,
        ): Long = signalWaitMs + endGraceMs + endGraceMs + exitCodeWaitMs + killExitWaitMs + SCAN_MARGIN_MS

        fun endTimeoutMs(signalWaitMs: Long = SIGNAL_WAIT_MS): Long = endWorstCaseMs(signalWaitMs) + TIMEOUT_HEADROOM_MS

        val END_TIMEOUT_MS: Long = endTimeoutMs()
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/NativeLinks.kt

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.util.Log
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

internal class NativeLinks(
    private val prefixDir: File,
    private val nativeLibDir: File,
    private val symlink: (target: String, link: String) -> Unit,
) {
    private val binDir = File(prefixDir, "bin")

    fun ensure() {
        binDir.mkdirs()

        for (name in STALE) {
            val f = File(binDir, name)
            if (f.exists() || Files.isSymbolicLink(f.toPath())) {
                f.delete()
                Log.d(TAG, "Removed stale: $name")
            }
        }
        val applets = binDir.listFiles()?.count { f ->
            val path = f.toPath()
            Files.isSymbolicLink(path) &&
                runCatching { Files.readSymbolicLink(path).toString() }.getOrNull() == "busybox" &&
                f.delete()
        } ?: 0
        if (applets > 0) Log.d(TAG, "Removed $applets busybox applet links")
        val scriptsDir = File(prefixDir, "scripts")
        if (scriptsDir.exists()) {
            scriptsDir.deleteRecursively()
            Log.d(TAG, "Removed stale scripts dir")
        }

        for ((name, lib) in LINKS) {
            val link = File(binDir, name)
            val target = File(nativeLibDir, lib)
            if (!target.exists()) {
                Log.w(TAG, "$lib not found in $nativeLibDir")
                continue
            }

            if (link.exists()) {
                if (link.canonicalPath == target.canonicalPath) continue
                link.delete()
            } else if (Files.isSymbolicLink(link.toPath())) {
                link.delete()
            }

            symlink(target.absolutePath, link.absolutePath)
            Log.d(TAG, "Symlink: $name -> ${target.absolutePath}")
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PR"
        val LINKS = mapOf(
            "proot" to "libproot.so",
            "pr-cli" to "libpr-cli.so",
        )
        val STALE = listOf("bash", "pr-test", "proot-distro", "busybox", "bootstrap.sh")
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.system.Os
import android.util.Log
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException

class PrBootstrap(
    private val context: Context,
    private val host: ProotHost,
    private val version: Int,
) {

    fun run() {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val currentVersion = prefs.getInt(KEY_VERSION, 0)
        val links = NativeLinks(host.prefixDir, File(context.applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir), Os::symlink)

        if (currentVersion < version) {
            bootstrap(prefs, links)
        } else {
            links.ensure()
            Log.i(TAG, "Already bootstrapped (version $currentVersion)")
        }
    }

    private fun bootstrap(prefs: SharedPreferences, links: NativeLinks) {
        Log.i(TAG, "Running bootstrap...")
        val t0 = System.currentTimeMillis()

        try {
            createDirectories(host)
            links.ensure()

            prefs.edit()
                .putInt(KEY_VERSION, version)
                .putBoolean(KEY_INITIALIZED, true)
                .apply()

            val elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0
            Log.i(TAG, "Bootstrap complete (${elapsed}ms)")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Bootstrap failed", e)
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PR"
        const val PREFS_NAME = "pr_prefs"
        const val KEY_INITIALIZED = "bootstrapped"
        const val KEY_VERSION = "bootstrap_version"
    }
}

internal fun createDirectories(host: ProotHost) {
    val dirs = listOf("tmp", "etc/pr", "var/lib/pr/installed-rootfs", "var/lib/pr/dlcache")
        .map { File(host.prefixDir, it) } + host.homeDir
    for (dir in dirs) {
        if (!dir.mkdirs() && !dir.isDirectory) throw IOException("cannot create $dir")
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.os.Process
import android.util.Log
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File

class PrCliCommand(
    private val host: ProotHost,
    private val runner: CommandRunner = ProcessRunner(Process.myPid(), Process::sendSignal),
) : DistroCommand {

    override suspend fun run(args: List<String>, onLine: (String) -> Unit): Int {
        val binDir = File(host.prefixDir, "bin")

        val env = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            mapOf(
                "APP_PREFIX" to host.prefixDir.absolutePath,
                "APP_HOME" to host.homeDir.absolutePath,
                "APP_PACKAGE" to host.packageName,
                "PATH" to "${binDir.absolutePath}:/system/bin:/system/xbin",
                "PROOT_NO_SECCOMP" to "1",
                "PROOT_TMP_DIR" to host.cacheDir.absolutePath,
                "HOME" to host.homeDir.absolutePath,
                "TERM" to "xterm-256color",
                "TMPDIR" to host.cacheDir.absolutePath,
                "APP_DNS_SERVERS" to host.dnsServers.joinToString(","),
            )
        }

        val prCli = File(binDir, "pr-cli").absolutePath
        val cmd = listOf(prCli) + args

        Log.d(TAG, "Running: ${cmd.joinToString(" ")}")
        val exitCode = runner.run(cmd, env) { line ->
            val cleaned = line
                .replace(ANSI_CSI, "")
                .replace(ANSI_OSC, "")
                .replace("\r", "")
                .trim()
            if (cleaned.isNotEmpty()) {
                Log.d(TAG, cleaned)
                onLine(cleaned)
            }
        }
        Log.d(TAG, "Exit code: $exitCode")
        return exitCode
    }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "PR"
        val ANSI_CSI = Regex("\\x1B\\[[0-9;]*[mGKHJ]")
        val ANSI_OSC = Regex("\\x1B\\]\\d+;.*?\\x07")
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ProcessRunner.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import kotlin.concurrent.thread

class ProcessRunner(
    private val parentPid: Int,
    private val signal: (pid: Int, signal: Int) -> Unit,
    private val processes: ProotProcesses = ProotProcesses(),
    private val stopWaitMs: Long = STOP_WAIT_MS,
) : CommandRunner {

    override suspend fun run(cmd: List<String>, env: Map<String, String>, onLine: (String) -> Unit): Int {
        val open = AtomicBoolean(true)
        val started = CompletableDeferred<Process?>()
        val code = AtomicReference<Int>()
        val exit = CompletableDeferred<Int>()
        thread(isDaemon = true, name = "process-output") {
            runCatching {
                val pb = ProcessBuilder(cmd)
                pb.environment().putAll(env)
                pb.redirectErrorStream(true)
                val proc = pb.start()
                started.complete(proc)
                proc.outputStream.close()
                proc.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { reader ->
                    var line = reader.readLine()
                    while (line != null) {
                        if (open.get()) onLine(line)
                        line = reader.readLine()
                    }
                }
                proc.waitFor().also(code::set)
            }.fold(exit::complete) {
                started.complete(null)
                exit.completeExceptionally(it)
            }
        }

        try {
            return exit.await()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            if (e is CancellationException) code.get()?.let { return it }
            val natural = withContext(NonCancellable) {
                started.await()?.let { proc ->
                    val natural = if (proc.isAlive) null else proc.exitValue()
                    val stopped = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
                    thread(isDaemon = true, name = "process-stop") {
                        try {
                            stop(proc, cmd)
                        } finally {
                            stopped.complete(Unit)
                        }
                    }
                    stopped.await()
                    if (withTimeoutOrNull(stopWaitMs) { exit.join() } == null) proc.inputStream.close()
                    natural
                }
            }
            open.set(false)
            if (e is CancellationException) natural?.let { return it }
            throw e
        }
    }

    private fun stop(proc: Process, cmd: List<String>) {
        runCatching {
            val roots = processes.children(parentPid, cmd)
            val tree = processes.descendants(roots)
            tree.forEach { signal(it, SIGTERM) }
            proc.destroy()
            if (exited(proc, tree)) return@runCatching
            (tree + processes.descendants(roots)).distinct()
                .filter { processes.alive(setOf(it)) }
                .forEach { signal(it, SIGKILL) }
            proc.destroyForcibly()
            proc.waitFor(stopWaitMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
        }
    }

    private fun exited(proc: Process, tree: List<Int>): Boolean {
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(stopWaitMs)
        while (proc.isAlive || processes.alive(tree.toSet())) {
            if (deadline - System.nanoTime() <= 0) return false
            Thread.sleep(POLL_MS)
        }
        return true
    }

    companion object {
        const val STOP_WAIT_MS = 2_000L
        private const val POLL_MS = 20L
        private const val SIGTERM = 15
        private const val SIGKILL = 9
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ProotProcesses.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import java.io.File

interface ProcFs {
    fun pids(): List<Int>
    fun status(pid: Int): String?
    fun stat(pid: Int): String?
    fun taskIds(pid: Int): List<Int>?
    fun children(pid: Int, tid: Int): String?
    fun cmdline(pid: Int): String?
    fun exists(pid: Int): Boolean
}

object SystemProcFs : ProcFs {
    override fun pids(): List<Int> = File("/proc").listFiles().orEmpty().mapNotNull { it.name.toIntOrNull() }

    override fun status(pid: Int): String? = read("/proc/$pid/status")

    override fun stat(pid: Int): String? = read("/proc/$pid/stat")

    override fun taskIds(pid: Int): List<Int>? =
        File("/proc/$pid/task").listFiles()?.mapNotNull { it.name.toIntOrNull() }

    override fun children(pid: Int, tid: Int): String? = read("/proc/$pid/task/$tid/children")

    override fun cmdline(pid: Int): String? = read("/proc/$pid/cmdline")

    override fun exists(pid: Int): Boolean = File("/proc/$pid").exists()

    private fun read(path: String): String? = runCatching { File(path).readText() }.getOrNull()
}

class ProotProcesses(private val proc: ProcFs = SystemProcFs) {

    fun shells(proot: Int): List<Int> = childrenOf(proot)

    fun endTargets(proot: Int, policy: EndPolicy = EndPolicy.SPARE_LOGIN_SHELL): Set<Int> {
        val shells = childrenOf(proot)
        val spared = if (policy == EndPolicy.SPARE_LOGIN_SHELL) shells.toSet() else emptySet()
        return traceesOf(proot, statuses(), exclude = spared + proot) ?: (shells - spared + descendantsOf(shells)).toSet()
    }

    fun alive(pids: Set<Int>): Boolean = pids.any { pid ->
        val state = proc.stat(pid)?.let(::processState)
        state != null && state != 'Z' && state != 'X'
    }

    fun forceKillTargets(proot: Int): List<Int> =
        forceKillTargets(proot, statuses()) { descendantsOf(listOf(proot)) }

    fun children(parent: Int, commandLine: List<String>): List<Int> =
        childrenOf(parent).filter { proc.cmdline(it)?.removeSuffix("\u0000")?.split('\u0000') == commandLine }

    fun descendants(roots: List<Int>): List<Int> = descendantsOf(roots)

    private fun childrenOf(pid: Int): List<Int> {
        val listed = listedChildren(pid)
        if (!listed.isNullOrEmpty()) return listed
        return childrenByParent()[pid].orEmpty()
    }

    private fun descendantsOf(roots: List<Int>): List<Int> {
        if (roots.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val byParent = if (listedChildren(roots.first()) == null) childrenByParent() else null
        fun children(pid: Int) = if (byParent != null) byParent[pid].orEmpty() else listedChildren(pid).orEmpty()
        val found = LinkedHashSet<Int>()
        val pending = ArrayDeque(roots.flatMap { children(it) })
        while (pending.isNotEmpty()) {
            val pid = pending.removeFirst()
            if (pid !in roots && found.add(pid)) pending.addAll(children(pid))
        }
        return found.toList()
    }

    private fun listedChildren(pid: Int): List<Int>? {
        val tasks = proc.taskIds(pid) ?: return null
        val lists = tasks.mapNotNull { tid -> proc.children(pid, tid) }
        if (lists.isEmpty()) return null
        return lists.flatMap { text -> text.trim().split(' ').mapNotNull { it.toIntOrNull() } }
    }

    private fun statuses(): Map<Int, String?> = buildMap {
        for (pid in proc.pids()) {
            val status = proc.status(pid)
            if (status != null || proc.exists(pid)) put(pid, status)
        }
    }

    private fun childrenByParent(): Map<Int, List<Int>> =
        proc.pids()
            .mapNotNull { child -> proc.stat(child)?.let(::parentPid)?.let { it to child } }
            .groupBy({ it.first }, { it.second })
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ProotPty.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.os.Process
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotLauncher

class ProotPty(
    private val session: ProotLauncher.Session,
    private val processes: ProotProcesses = ProotProcesses(),
    private val endPolicy: EndPolicy = EndPolicy.SPARE_LOGIN_SHELL,
) : Pty {

    override fun read(buf: ByteArray): Int = session.read(buf)

    override fun write(data: ByteArray): Int = session.write(data)

    override fun resize(rows: Int, cols: Int) {
        session.resize(rows, cols)
    }

    override fun signalTracees(): Set<Int> {
        if (session.exitCode != null || session.pid <= 0) return emptySet()
        val targets = processes.endTargets(session.pid, endPolicy)
        targets.forEach { pid -> END_SIGNALS.forEach { Process.sendSignal(pid, it) } }
        return targets
    }

    override fun alive(pids: Set<Int>): Boolean = processes.alive(pids)

    override fun sendEof() {
        session.write(byteArrayOf(0x04))
    }

    override fun kill() {
        if (session.exitCode != null || session.pid <= 0) return
        processes.shells(session.pid).forEach { Process.sendSignal(it, Process.SIGNAL_KILL) }
    }

    override fun forceKill() {
        if (session.exitCode != null || session.pid <= 0) return
        processes.forceKillTargets(session.pid).forEach { Process.sendSignal(it, Process.SIGNAL_KILL) }
    }

    override fun close() {
        session.close()
    }

    override val exitCode: Int?
        get() = session.exitCode
}

private val END_SIGNALS = listOf(15, 18)

internal fun parentPid(stat: String): Int? {
    val afterName = stat.substringAfterLast(')', missingDelimiterValue = "").trim()
    return afterName.split(' ').getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
}

internal fun processState(stat: String): Char? =
    stat.substringAfterLast(')', missingDelimiterValue = "").trim().split(' ').firstOrNull()?.singleOrNull()

internal fun tracerPid(status: String): Int? =
    status.lineSequence().firstOrNull { it.startsWith("TracerPid:") }?.substringAfter(':')?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()

internal fun traceesOf(tracer: Int, statuses: Map<Int, String?>, exclude: Set<Int>): Set<Int>? {
    val tracees = LinkedHashSet<Int>()
    for ((pid, status) in statuses) {
        val tracedBy = status?.let(::tracerPid) ?: return null
        if (tracedBy == tracer && pid !in exclude) tracees += pid
    }
    return tracees
}

internal fun forceKillTargets(proot: Int, statuses: Map<Int, String?>, walk: () -> List<Int>): List<Int> {
    val tracees = traceesOf(proot, statuses, exclude = setOf(proot)) ?: walk()
    return tracees.filter { it != proot }.distinct() + proot
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.os.Looper
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotLauncher
import org.connectbot.terminal.TerminalEmulatorFactory
import java.io.File

class ProotSessionFactory internal constructor(
    private val host: ProotHost,
    private val binds: List<Bind>,
    private val startSession: (List<String>) -> ProotLauncher.Session?,
) : SessionManager.SessionFactory {

    @JvmOverloads
    constructor(host: ProotHost, binds: List<Bind> = emptyList()) :
        this(host, binds, { args -> ProotLauncher(host).startCustomSession(args, rows = 24, cols = 80) })

    override fun create(alias: String, onEnded: (ManagedSession) -> Unit): ManagedSession {
        val session = startLogin(alias)
        val pty = ProotPty(session)
        try {
            lateinit var managed: ManagedSession
            val emulator = TerminalEmulatorFactory.create(
                looper = Looper.getMainLooper(),
                initialRows = 24,
                initialCols = 80,
                defaultForeground = Color.White,
                defaultBackground = Color(0xFF1a1a2e),
                onKeyboardInput = { data -> managed.write(data) },
                onResize = { dims -> managed.resize(dims.rows, dims.columns) },
            )
            managed = ManagedSession(
                alias = alias,
                pty = pty,
                emulator = emulator,
                output = { buf, off, len -> emulator.writeInput(buf, off, len) },
                onEnded = onEnded,
            )
            return managed
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            pty.forceKill()
            session.close()
            throw t
        }
    }

    internal fun startLogin(alias: String): ProotLauncher.Session {
        val prCli = File(host.prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli")
        check(prCli.exists()) { "could not start a terminal for $alias: no pr-cli at $prCli" }
        binds.forEach { bind ->
            check(File(bind.hostPath).exists()) { "could not start a terminal for $alias: no bind source ${bind.hostPath}" }
        }
        return startSession(terminalArgs(host.prefixDir, alias, binds))
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("could not start a terminal for $alias")
    }
}

internal fun terminalArgs(prefixDir: File, container: String, binds: List<Bind>): List<String> =
    listOf(File(prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli").absolutePath, "login", container, "--user", "root") +
        binds.flatMap { listOf("--custom-bind", "${it.hostPath}:${it.guestPath}") }

package id.or.oo.pr.session

internal class ServiceState {

    sealed interface Action {
        data class StartForeground(val running: List<String>, val awake: Boolean) : Action
        data class Notify(val running: List<String>, val awake: Boolean) : Action
        data class WakeLock(val on: Boolean) : Action
        data class Stop(val startId: Int) : Action
    }

    private var foreground = false
    private var lastStartId = 0

    fun onStartCommand(startId: Int, running: List<String>, awake: Boolean): List<Action> {
        lastStartId = startId
        foreground = true
        return if (running.isEmpty()) listOf(Action.StartForeground(running, awake), stop())
        else listOf(Action.StartForeground(running, awake))
    }

    fun onRunningChanged(running: List<String>, awake: Boolean): List<Action> = buildList {
        add(Action.WakeLock(awake && running.isNotEmpty()))
        if (running.isNotEmpty()) add(Action.Notify(running, awake))
        else if (foreground) add(stop())
    }

    private fun stop(): Action {
        foreground = false
        return Action.Stop(lastStartId)
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/SessionManager.kt
