package id.or.oo.pr.session

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow

class SessionManager(
    private val factory: SessionFactory,
    private val foreground: ForegroundController,
    private val notifier: EndedNotifier,
) {
    fun interface SessionFactory {
        fun create(alias: String, onEnded: (ManagedSession) -> Unit): ManagedSession
    }

    interface ForegroundController {
        fun start()
    }

    fun interface EndedNotifier {
        fun sessionEnded(alias: String, exitCode: Int?)
    }

    sealed interface OpenResult {
        data class Opened(val session: ManagedSession) : OpenResult
        data class Ending(val session: ManagedSession) : OpenResult
        data class Failed(val reason: String) : OpenResult
    }

    private val lock = Any()
    private val sessions = LinkedHashMap<String, ManagedSession>()
    private val kinds = HashMap<String, Class<out SessionFactory>>()
    private val retained = HashSet<ManagedSession>()

    private val _running = MutableStateFlow<List<String>>(emptyList())
    val running: StateFlow<List<String>> = _running

    private val _ending = MutableStateFlow<List<String>>(emptyList())
    val ending: StateFlow<List<String>> = _ending

    private val _keepCpuAwake = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val keepCpuAwake: StateFlow<Boolean> = _keepCpuAwake

    fun setKeepCpuAwake(on: Boolean) {
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (_running.value.isNotEmpty()) _keepCpuAwake.value = on
        }
    }

    private val _backgroundError = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val backgroundError: StateFlow<String?> = _backgroundError

    fun open(alias: String, factory: SessionFactory = this.factory): OpenResult {
        val session = synchronized(lock) {
            val existing = sessions[alias]
            if (existing != null) {
                val wasRetained = existing in retained
                if ((existing.exit.value == null || wasRetained) && kinds[alias] != factory.javaClass) {
                    return OpenResult.Failed("$alias is already open as another kind of session")
                }
                if (existing.exit.value == null && existing.endRequested) return OpenResult.Ending(existing)
                if (existing.exit.value == null || wasRetained) return OpenResult.Opened(existing)
                sessions.remove(alias)
            }
            val created = try {
                factory.create(alias, ::onEnded)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                return OpenResult.Failed(e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName)
            }
            created.onEndRequested = { synchronized(lock) { updateEnding() } }
            sessions[alias] = created
            kinds[alias] = factory.javaClass
            updateRunning()
            created
        }
        session.start()
        return OpenResult.Opened(session)
    }

    fun foregroundStarted() {
        synchronized(lock) { _backgroundError.value = null }
    }

    fun attach(session: ManagedSession, screen: ManagedSession.Screen) {
        val previous = synchronized(lock) {
            retained.remove(session)
            session.attach(screen)
        }
        previous?.close()
    }

    fun setVisible(session: ManagedSession, screen: ManagedSession.Screen, visible: Boolean) {
        session.setVisible(screen, visible)
    }

    fun detach(session: ManagedSession, screen: ManagedSession.Screen, retainEnded: Boolean = false) {
        synchronized(lock) {
            session.detach(screen)
            if (session.hasScreen || sessions[session.alias] !== session) return
            if (retainEnded) {
                retained += session
            } else if (session.exit.value != null) {
                sessions.remove(session.alias)
                updateRunning()
            }
        }
    }

    fun end(alias: String) {
        synchronized(lock) { sessions[alias] }?.end()
    }

    fun endAll() {
        synchronized(lock) { sessions.values.toList() }.forEach { it.end() }
    }

    private fun onEnded(session: ManagedSession) {
        var notify = false
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (sessions[session.alias] !== session) return
            val awaited = session in retained
            if (!session.hasScreen && !awaited) sessions.remove(session.alias)
            notify = !session.endRequested && !awaited && !session.screenVisible
            updateRunning()
        }
        if (notify) notifier.sessionEnded(session.alias, session.exit.value?.code)
    }

    private fun updateRunning() {
        val before = _running.value.size
        val now = sessions.values.filter { it.exit.value == null }.map { it.alias }
        if (before == 0 && now.isNotEmpty()) {
            _running.value = now
            startForeground()
        } else {
            if (before > 0 && now.isEmpty()) {
                _keepCpuAwake.value = false
                _backgroundError.value = null
            }
            _running.value = now
        }
        updateEnding()
    }

    private fun updateEnding() {
        _ending.value = sessions.values.filter { it.endRequested && it.exit.value == null }.map { it.alias }
    }

    private fun startForeground() {
        try {
            foreground.start()
            _backgroundError.value = null
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            _backgroundError.value = e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName
        }
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/SessionNotifications.kt

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat

object SessionNotifications {
    const val RUNNING_ID = 1
    private const val CHANNEL_RUNNING = "sessions_running"
    private const val CHANNEL_ENDED = "sessions_ended"

    fun createChannels(context: Context) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
        manager.createNotificationChannel(
            NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_RUNNING, "Running sessions", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW)
        )
        manager.createNotificationChannel(
            NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ENDED, "Session ended", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT)
        )
    }

    fun running(
        context: Context,
        aliases: List<String>,
        keepAwake: Boolean,
        exempt: Boolean,
        ending: List<String> = emptyList(),
    ): Notification {
        val title = runningTitle(aliases, ending)
        val details = runningText(aliases, ending, keepAwake, exempt)
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_RUNNING)
            .setSmallIcon(context.sessionHost.notificationIcon)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(details)
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(details))
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
            .setContentIntent(openList(context))
            .addAction(0, "End all", serviceAction(context, SessionActions.endAll(context.packageName)))
            .addAction(
                0,
                if (keepAwake) "Let CPU sleep" else "Keep CPU awake",
                serviceAction(context, SessionActions.toggleWake(context.packageName)),
            )
            .build()
    }

    fun ended(context: Context, alias: String, exitCode: Int?): Notification {
        val code = exitCode?.toString() ?: "unknown"
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ENDED)
            .setSmallIcon(context.sessionHost.notificationIcon)
            .setContentTitle("$alias: session ended (exit $code)")
            .setContentIntent(openList(context))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .build()
    }

    private fun openList(context: Context): PendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
        context,
        0,
        context.sessionHost.openAppIntent()
            .addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP),
        PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
    )

    private fun serviceAction(context: Context, action: String): PendingIntent = PendingIntent.getService(
        context,
        action.hashCode(),
        Intent(context, SessionService::class.java).setAction(action),
        PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
    )
}

internal fun runningText(aliases: List<String>, ending: List<String>, keepAwake: Boolean, exempt: Boolean): String {
    val (stopping, active) = aliases.partition { it in ending }
    return buildList {
        if (active.isNotEmpty()) add(active.joinToString(", "))
        if (stopping.isNotEmpty()) add("Stopping ${stopping.joinToString(", ")}…")
        if (keepAwake) add("CPU kept awake")
        if (keepAwake && !exempt) add("Battery saver may stop sessions; allow in the app")
    }.joinToString(" · ")
}

internal fun runningTitle(aliases: List<String>, ending: List<String> = emptyList()): String {
    val stopping = aliases.count { it in ending }
    val active = aliases.size - stopping
    return when {
        aliases.isEmpty() -> "Stopping…"
        active == 0 -> if (stopping == 1) "Stopping 1 session…" else "Stopping $stopping sessions…"
        active == 1 -> "1 session running"
        else -> "$active sessions running"
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/main/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/SessionService.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.PowerManager
import androidx.core.app.ServiceCompat
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class SessionService : Service() {

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main.immediate)
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
    private val state = ServiceState()
    private val sessions: SessionManager get() = sessionHost.sessions

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        SessionNotifications.createChannels(this)
        scope.launch {
            combine(sessions.running, sessions.ending, sessions.keepCpuAwake) { running, _, awake -> running to awake }
                .collect { (running, awake) -> execute(state.onRunningChanged(running, awake)) }
        }
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        execute(state.onStartCommand(startId, sessions.running.value, sessions.keepCpuAwake.value))
        when (intent?.action) {
            SessionActions.endAll(packageName) -> sessions.endAll()
            SessionActions.toggleWake(packageName) -> sessions.setKeepCpuAwake(!sessions.keepCpuAwake.value)
        }
        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    private fun execute(actions: List<ServiceState.Action>) {
        for (action in actions) {
            when (action) {
                is ServiceState.Action.StartForeground -> {
                    ServiceCompat.startForeground(
                        this,
                        SessionNotifications.RUNNING_ID,
                        notification(action.running, action.awake),
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE else 0,
                    )
                    sessions.foregroundStarted()
                }
                is ServiceState.Action.Notify -> getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
                    .notify(SessionNotifications.RUNNING_ID, notification(action.running, action.awake))
                is ServiceState.Action.WakeLock -> setWakeLock(action.on)
                is ServiceState.Action.Stop -> {
                    ServiceCompat.stopForeground(this, ServiceCompat.STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
                    stopSelfResult(action.startId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        scope.cancel()
        setWakeLock(false)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun notification(running: List<String>, awake: Boolean) =
        SessionNotifications.running(this, running, awake, isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(), sessions.ending.value)

    private fun setWakeLock(on: Boolean) {
        val held = wakeLock
        if (on && held == null) {
            wakeLock = getSystemService(PowerManager::class.java)
                .newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "pr:sessions")
                .apply { acquire() }
        } else if (!on && held != null) {
            if (held.isHeld) held.release()
            wakeLock = null
        }
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class BindTest {

    private fun rejected(hostPath: String, guestPath: String): String =
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { Bind(hostPath, guestPath) }.message!!

    @Test
    fun aBlankHostPathIsRejected() {
        assertEquals("bind host path must be absolute: \" \"", rejected(" ", "/srv"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aBlankGuestPathIsRejected() {
        assertEquals("bind guest path must be absolute: \"\"", rejected("/sdcard/srv", ""))
    }

    @Test
    fun aRelativeHostPathIsRejected() {
        assertEquals("bind host path must be absolute: \"files/home\"", rejected("files/home", "/srv"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aRelativeGuestPathIsRejected() {
        assertEquals("bind guest path must be absolute: \"srv\"", rejected("/sdcard/srv", "srv"))
    }

    @Test
    fun aHostPathWithAColonIsRejected() {
        assertEquals(
            "bind host path must not contain ':': \"/sdcard/a:b\"",
            rejected("/sdcard/a:b", "/srv"),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun absolutePathsWithoutAColonInTheHostPathAreAccepted() {
        assertEquals("/root/a:b", Bind("/sdcard/srv", "/root/a:b").guestPath)
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotLauncher
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

class CommandSessionTest {

    private val literalPrefix = File("/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr")
    private val root = Files.createTempDirectory("command-session").toFile()
    private val host = object : ProotHost {
        override val prefixDir = File(root, "usr")
        override val homeDir = File(root, "home")
        override val packageName = "org.example.gateway"
        override val cacheDir = File(root, "cache")
    }
    private val prCli = File(host.prefixDir, "bin/pr-cli").apply {
        parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        createNewFile()
    }

    private val container = "debian"
    private val key = "web-server"
    private val command = "httpd -f -p 8080 && echo 'server stopped'"
    private val literalBinds = listOf(
        Bind("/storage/emulated/0/Download", "/root/Download"),
        Bind("/data/data/org.example.host/files/home/srv", "/srv"),
    )
    private val binds = listOf(
        Bind(File(root, "Download").apply { mkdirs() }.path, "/root/Download"),
        Bind(File(root, "srv").apply { mkdirs() }.path, "/srv"),
    )

    private val started = CopyOnWriteArrayList<List<String>>()
    private val ptys = CopyOnWriteArrayList<FakePty>()
    private val received = StringBuffer()
    private val ended = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Pair<String, Int?>>()

    private val sessions = SessionManager(
        { alias, onEnded ->
            val pty = FakePty().also { ptys += it }
            ManagedSession(alias, pty, null, { _, _, _ -> }, onEnded, exitCodeWaitMs = 100)
        },
        object : SessionManager.ForegroundController {
            override fun start() {}
        },
    ) { alias, code -> ended += alias to code }

    private val toReceived: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit = { buf, off, len -> received.append(String(buf, off, len)) }

    private val launched = ConcurrentHashMap<ProotLauncher.Session, Pty>()

    private fun factory(
        sink: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit = toReceived,
        binds: List<Bind> = this.binds,
        start: (List<String>) -> Pty? = { args -> started += args; FakePty().also { ptys += it } },
        signalWaitMs: Long = ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS,
    ) = CommandSessionFactory(
        host,
        container,
        command,
        sink,
        binds,
        startSession = { args -> start(args)?.let { pty -> ProotLauncher.Session(-1).also { launched[it] = pty } } },
        pty = { session, _ -> launched.getValue(session) },
        signalWaitMs = signalWaitMs,
    )

    private fun openCommand(): ManagedSession =
        (sessions.open(key, factory()) as SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened).session

    private val app = 1700
    private val proot = 1790
    private val shell = 1804
    private val gateway = 1810

    private class CommandProcess(
        private val proc: FakeProcFs,
        private val proot: Int,
        private val exitsOnSigtermOf: Int,
        val pty: FakePty = FakePty().apply { ignoresEof = true },
    ) : Pty by pty {
        val sigterm = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Int>()

        override fun signalTracees(): Set<Int> {
            pty.signalTracees()
            val targets = ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot, CommandSessionFactory.END_POLICY)
            sigterm += targets
            if (exitsOnSigtermOf in targets) pty.exit(143)
            return targets
        }
    }

    private fun endCommand(proc: FakeProcFs, exitsOnSigtermOf: Int): CommandProcess {
        val process = CommandProcess(proc, proot, exitsOnSigtermOf).also { ptys += it.pty }
        sessions.open(key, factory(start = { args -> started += args; process }))
        sessions.end(key)
        eventually(timeoutMs = 10_000) { sessions.running.value.isEmpty() }
        return process
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        ptys.forEach { it.exit(0) }
        root.deleteRecursively()
    }

    @Test
    fun theLoginArgumentsCarryEachBindAndTheCommandAsOneArgumentAfterTheSeparator() {
        assertEquals(
            listOf(
                "/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr/bin/pr-cli",
                "login",
                "debian",
                "--user",
                "root",
                "--custom-bind",
                "/storage/emulated/0/Download:/root/Download",
                "--custom-bind",
                "/data/data/org.example.host/files/home/srv:/srv",
                "--",
                "httpd -f -p 8080 && echo 'server stopped'",
            ),
            loginArgs(literalPrefix, "debian", command, literalBinds),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun withoutBindsTheSeparatorFollowsTheUser() {
        assertEquals(
            listOf("/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr/bin/pr-cli", "login", "alpine", "--user", "root", "--", "top -b"),
            loginArgs(literalPrefix, "alpine", "top -b", emptyList()),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun theFactoryLogsIntoItsContainerNotIntoTheSessionKey() {
        openCommand()

        assertEquals(listOf(loginArgs(host.prefixDir, container, command, binds)), started)
        assertEquals(container, started.single()[2])
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandSessionHasNoEmulatorAndItsOutputReachesTheSink() {
        val session = openCommand()

        ptys.single().emit("gateway listening on 8080\n")

        eventually { received.toString() == "gateway listening on 8080\n" }
        assertNull(session.emulator)
        assertEquals(listOf(key), sessions.running.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun endStopsACommandSessionTheWayItStopsATerminalSession() {
        openCommand()
        val pty = ptys.single()

        sessions.end(key)

        eventually { sessions.running.value.isEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertTrue(ended.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun endAllStopsCommandAndTerminalSessionsTogether() {

        openCommand()

        eventually { sessions.running.value.isEmpty() }

    @Test

    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandThatCannotStartIsReportedAndNothingRuns() {

        assertEquals(SessionManager.OpenResult.Failed("could not start a command session for web-server"), result)
        assertTrue(sessions.running.value.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test

        val terminal = sessions.open(container)
        openCommand()

        assertTrue(terminal is SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened)
        assertEquals(listOf(container, key), sessions.running.value)
        assertEquals(container, started.single()[2])
        assertEquals(2, ptys.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandSessionCannotTakeTheKeyOfARunningTerminal() {

    @Test
    fun anEndedTerminalStillOnItsScreenGivesItsKeyToACommandSession() {

        ptys.single().exit(0)
        eventually { terminal.exit.value != null }

        val result = sessions.open(container, factory())

        assertTrue(result is SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened && result.session !== terminal)
        assertEquals(listOf(container), sessions.running.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun aRetainedEndedTerminalKeepsItsKeyFromACommandSession() {
        val terminal = (sessions.open(container) as SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened).session
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        sessions.attach(terminal, screen)
        sessions.detach(terminal, screen, retainEnded = true)

    @Test

    @Test
    fun endSendsSigtermToACommandThatIsProotsDirectChildAndDrainsWithoutAKill() {
        val proc = FakeProcFs(childrenFiles = false).apply {
            add(app, ppid = 1)
            add(proot, ppid = app)
            add(gateway, ppid = proot, tracer = proot, cmdline = listOf("httpd", "-f", "-p", "8080"))
        }

        val process = endCommand(proc, exitsOnSigtermOf = gateway)

        assertEquals(listOf(gateway), process.sigterm)
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "close"), process.pty.calls)
        assertFalse(process.pty.killed)
        assertFalse(process.pty.forceKilled)
    }

    @Test
    fun endSendsSigtermToAShellThatStayedAndToItsCommand() {
        val proc = FakeProcFs(childrenFiles = false).apply {
            add(app, ppid = 1)
            add(proot, ppid = app)
            add(shell, ppid = proot, tracer = proot, cmdline = listOf("/bin/sh", "-l", "-c", command))
            add(gateway, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, cmdline = listOf("httpd", "-f", "-p", "8080"))
        }

        val process = endCommand(proc, exitsOnSigtermOf = shell)

        assertEquals(setOf(shell, gateway), process.sigterm.toSet())
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "close"), process.pty.calls)
        assertFalse(process.pty.killed)
    }

    @Test
    fun aSinkThatThrowsLosesOnlyThatOutputAndTheSessionKeepsRunning() {
        val writes = AtomicInteger()
        sessions.open(key, factory(sink = { buf, off, len ->
            if (writes.getAndIncrement() == 0) throw IllegalStateException("log full")
            toReceived(buf, off, len)
        }))

        ptys.single().emit("first\n")
        ptys.single().emit("second\n")

        eventually { received.toString() == "second\n" }
        assertEquals(listOf(key), sessions.running.value)
        assertEquals(2, writes.get())
    }

    @Test

        }

        assertEquals("command must not be blank", e.message)
    }

    @Test

        assertEquals(

            result,
        )
        assertTrue(started.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(sessions.running.value.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(ended.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun endWaitsTheFactorysSignalWaitForTheServerBeforeTheEof() {
        val pty = FakePty().apply { signalled = setOf(gateway) }
        val session = (sessions.open(key, factory(signalWaitMs = 1_500, start = { args -> started += args; pty.also { ptys += it } }))
            as SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened).session

        session.end()

        eventually(timeoutMs = 10_000) { session.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") >= 1_500)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") < ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS)

    @Test
    fun aSignalWaitThatIsNotPositiveIsRejectedWhenTheFactoryIsBuilt() {
        val e = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived, binds, signalWaitMs = 0)
        }

        assertEquals("signalWaitMs must be between 1 and 3600000: 0", e.message)
    }

    @Test
    fun thePublicConstructorPassesTheSignalWaitItIsGiven() {
        val given = CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived, binds, signalWaitMs = 65_000)
        val defaulted = CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived)

        assertEquals(65_000L, given.signalWaitMs)
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS, defaulted.signalWaitMs)
    }

    @Test
    fun aSignalWaitOverAnHourIsRejectedWhenTheFactoryIsBuilt() {
        CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived, binds, signalWaitMs = 3_600_000)
        val over = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived, binds, signalWaitMs = 3_600_001)
        }
        val max = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CommandSessionFactory(host, container, command, toReceived, binds, signalWaitMs = Long.MAX_VALUE)
        }

        assertEquals("signalWaitMs must be between 1 and 3600000: 3600001", over.message)
        assertEquals("signalWaitMs must be between 1 and 3600000: ${Long.MAX_VALUE}", max.message)
    }

    @Test
    fun theFactorysPtySendsSigtermToEveryTraceeIncludingProotsDirectChild() {
        val proc = FakeProcFs(childrenFiles = false).apply {
            add(app, ppid = 1)
            add(proot, ppid = app)
            add(gateway, ppid = proot, tracer = proot, cmdline = listOf("httpd", "-f", "-p", "8080"))
            add(1820, ppid = gateway, tracer = proot)
        }
        val factory = CommandSessionFactory(
            host,
            container,
            command,
            toReceived,
            binds,
            startSession = { args -> started += args; ProotLauncher.Session(-1, proot) },
            processes = ProotProcesses(proc),
        )

        val pty = factory.startPty(key)

        assertEquals(setOf(gateway, 1820), pty.signalTracees())
        assertEquals(listOf(loginArgs(host.prefixDir, container, command, binds)), started)
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

class FakeProcFs(private val childrenFiles: Boolean) : ProcFs {

    private class Proc(
        val ppid: Int,
        val tracer: Int,
        val state: Char,
        val forkedBy: Int,
        val threads: List<Int>,
        val statusReadable: Boolean,
        val statReadable: Boolean,
        val cmdline: List<String>,
    )

    private val procs = LinkedHashMap<Int, Proc>()
    private val vanishing = HashMap<Int, MutableList<Int>>()
    private val vanished = HashSet<Int>()
    private var listings = 0
    val readsAfterVanishing = mutableListOf<String>()

    fun add(
        pid: Int,
        ppid: Int,
        tracer: Int = 0,
        state: Char = 'S',
        forkedBy: Int = ppid,
        threads: List<Int> = emptyList(),
        statusReadable: Boolean = true,
        statReadable: Boolean = true,
        cmdline: List<String> = listOf("sh"),
    ) {
        procs[pid] = Proc(ppid, tracer, state, forkedBy, threads, statusReadable, statReadable, cmdline)
    }

    fun vanishAfterListing(pid: Int, listing: Int) {
        vanishing.getOrPut(listing) { mutableListOf() } += pid
    }

    override fun pids(): List<Int> {
        val listed = procs.keys.toList()
        listings++
        vanishing.remove(listings)?.forEach {
            procs.remove(it)
            vanished += it
        }
        return listed
    }

    private fun <T> read(kind: String, pid: Int, value: (Proc) -> T?): T? {
        if (pid in vanished) readsAfterVanishing += "$kind $pid"
        return procs[pid]?.let(value)
    }

    override fun status(pid: Int): String? = read("status", pid) {
        if (!it.statusReadable) null
        else "Name:\tsh\nState:\t${it.state}\nTgid:\t$pid\nPid:\t$pid\nPPid:\t${it.ppid}\nTracerPid:\t${it.tracer}\nUid:\t10200\n"
    }

    override fun stat(pid: Int): String? = read("stat", pid) {
        if (!it.statReadable) null else "$pid (s h) ${it.state} ${it.ppid} $pid $pid 0 -1 4194304"
    }

    override fun taskIds(pid: Int): List<Int>? = read("task", pid) { listOf(pid) + it.threads }

    override fun children(pid: Int, tid: Int): String? {
        if (!childrenFiles) return null
        return read("children", pid) { _ ->
            procs.filterValues { it.ppid == pid && it.forkedBy == tid }.keys.joinToString("") { "$it " }
        }
    }

    override fun cmdline(pid: Int): String? = read("cmdline", pid) { proc ->
        if (proc.state == 'Z') "" else proc.cmdline.joinToString("") { "$it\u0000" }
    }

    override fun exists(pid: Int): Boolean = read("exists", pid) { true } ?: false
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertThrows;

import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import kotlin.Unit;
import kotlin.io.FilesKt;
import kotlin.jvm.functions.Function3;
import org.junit.After;
import org.junit.Test;

public class JavaHostTest {

    private final File root = createRoot();
    private final File prCli = new File(new File(root, "usr"), "bin/pr-cli");

    private final ProotHost host = new ProotHost() {
        @Override
        public File getPrefixDir() {
            return new File(root, "usr");
        }

        @Override
        public File getHomeDir() {
            return new File(root, "home");
        }

        @Override
        public String getPackageName() {
            return "org.example.host";
        }

        @Override
        public File getCacheDir() {
            return new File(root, "cache");
        }

        @Override
        public List<String> getDnsServers() {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
    };

    private final Function3<byte[], Integer, Integer, Unit> sink = (buf, off, len) -> Unit.INSTANCE;

    private static File createRoot() {
        try {
            return Files.createTempDirectory("java-host").toFile();
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        FilesKt.deleteRecursively(root);
    }

    @Test
    public void aJavaHostBuildsATerminalFactoryWithTheHostAlone() {
        ProotSessionFactory factory = new ProotSessionFactory(host);

        IllegalStateException e = assertThrows(
            IllegalStateException.class,
            () -> factory.create("debian", session -> Unit.INSTANCE)
        );

        assertEquals("could not start a terminal for debian: no pr-cli at " + prCli, e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    public void aJavaHostBuildsATerminalFactoryWithBinds() throws java.io.IOException {
        prCli.getParentFile().mkdirs();
        prCli.createNewFile();
        File missing = new File(root, "absent");
        ProotSessionFactory factory =
            new ProotSessionFactory(host, Collections.singletonList(new Bind(missing.getPath(), "/mnt")));

        IllegalStateException e = assertThrows(
            IllegalStateException.class,
            () -> factory.create("debian", session -> Unit.INSTANCE)
        );

        assertEquals("could not start a terminal for debian: no bind source " + missing, e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    public void aJavaHostBuildsACommandFactoryWithoutBindsOrASignalWait() {
        CommandSessionFactory factory = new CommandSessionFactory(host, "debian", "exec server", sink);

        IllegalStateException e = assertThrows(
            IllegalStateException.class,
            () -> factory.create("web-server", session -> Unit.INSTANCE)
        );

        assertEquals("could not start a command session for web-server: no pr-cli at " + prCli, e.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    public void aJavaHostBuildsACommandFactoryWithBindsAndASignalWait() {
        List<Bind> binds = Collections.singletonList(new Bind(root.getPath(), "/srv"));
        List<CommandSessionFactory> factories = List.of(
            new CommandSessionFactory(host, "debian", "exec server", sink, binds),
            new CommandSessionFactory(host, "debian", "exec server", sink, binds, 65_000L)
        );

        for (CommandSessionFactory factory : factories) {
            IllegalStateException e = assertThrows(
                IllegalStateException.class,
                () -> factory.create("web-server", session -> Unit.INSTANCE)
            );
            assertEquals("could not start a command session for web-server: no pr-cli at " + prCli, e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

class ManagedSessionTest {

    private val pty = FakePty()
    private val output = StringBuffer()
    private val ended = CopyOnWriteArrayList<ManagedSession>()

    private fun session(
        endGraceMs: Long = 100,
        signalWaitMs: Long = 100,
        sink: (ByteArray, Int, Int) -> Unit = { buf, off, len -> output.append(String(buf, off, len)) },
    ) = ManagedSession(
        alias = "alpine",
        pty = pty,
        emulator = null,
        output = sink,
        onEnded = { ended += it },
        endGraceMs = endGraceMs,
        signalWaitMs = signalWaitMs,
        exitCodeWaitMs = 100,
    ).also { it.start() }

    @Test
    fun drainsOutputWithNoScreenAttached() {
        val s = session()
        pty.emit("hello ")
        pty.emit("world")
        eventually { output.toString() == "hello world" }
        assertFalse(s.hasScreen)
    }

    @Test
    fun programExitRecordsTheCodeAndClosesThePty() {
        val s = session()
        pty.exit(3)
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.Exit(3), s.exit.value)
        assertTrue(pty.closed)
        assertSame(s, ended.single())
        assertFalse(s.endRequested)
    }

    @Test
    fun aReaderFailureWithNoExitCodeKillsTheShellBeforeClosing() {
        session()
        pty.failRead()
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("kill", "close"), pty.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun aReaderFailureForceKillsWhenTheKillDoesNotEndIt() {
        pty.ignoresKill = true
        session()
        pty.failRead()
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("kill", "forceKill", "close"), pty.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun aProgramExitDoesNotForceKill() {
        session()
        pty.exit(0)
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("close"), pty.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun endSendsEofAndMarksTheEndRequested() {
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 1_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertTrue(pty.eofSent)
        assertFalse(pty.killed)
        assertTrue(s.endRequested)
    }

    @Test
    fun endKillsTheProgramWhenItIgnoresEof() {
        pty.ignoresEof = true
        val s = session()
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertTrue(pty.killed)
        assertFalse(pty.forceKilled)
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.Exit(137), s.exit.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun endForceKillsWhenTheKillDoesNotEndIt() {
        pty.ignoresEof = true
        pty.ignoresKill = true
        val s = session()
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertTrue(pty.forceKilled)
    }

    @Test
    fun endSignalsThenWaitsThenSendsEofThenKills() {
        pty.signalled = setOf(42)
        pty.ignoresEof = true
        pty.ignoresKill = true
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 1_000, signalWaitMs = 300)
        s.end()
        eventually(timeoutMs = 10_000) { s.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "kill", "forceKill", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") >= 300)
        assertTrue(pty.aliveQueries.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(pty.aliveQueries.all { it == setOf(42) })
    }

    @Test
    fun endSendsEofOnceTheSignalledProgramsHaveExited() {
        pty.signalled = setOf(42)
        pty.signalledExitAfterMs = 200
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 2_000, signalWaitMs = 3_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") >= 150)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") < 1_500)
    }

    @Test
    fun theSlowestEndFinishesWithinTheDerivedWorstCase() {
        pty.signalled = setOf(42)
        pty.ignoresEof = true
        pty.ignoresKill = true
        pty.forceKillLeavesNoExitCode = true
        val s = ManagedSession(
            alias = "alpine",
            pty = pty,
            emulator = null,
            output = { _, _, _ -> },
            onEnded = { ended += it },
            endGraceMs = 1_000,
            signalWaitMs = 1_000,
            exitCodeWaitMs = 1_000,
            killExitWaitMs = 1_000,
        ).also { it.start() }
        val worstWithoutMargin = ManagedSession.endWorstCaseMs(
            signalWaitMs = 1_000,
            endGraceMs = 1_000,
            exitCodeWaitMs = 1_000,
            killExitWaitMs = 1_000,
        ) - ManagedSession.SCAN_MARGIN_MS
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        s.end()
        eventually(timeoutMs = 15_000) { s.exit.value != null }
        val tookMs = (System.nanoTime() - started) / 1_000_000
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "kill", "forceKill", "kill", "forceKill", "close"), pty.calls)
        val worst = ManagedSession.endWorstCaseMs(
            signalWaitMs = 1_000,
            endGraceMs = 1_000,
            exitCodeWaitMs = 1_000,
            killExitWaitMs = 1_000,
        )
        assertTrue("took $tookMs ms", tookMs >= worstWithoutMargin && tookMs < worst)
    }

    @Test
    fun endSendsEofAtOnceWhenNothingWasSignalled() {
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 2_000, signalWaitMs = 3_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertTrue(pty.msBetween("signal", "eof") < 500)
        assertTrue(pty.aliveQueries.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun aBlockedEofDoesNotDelayTheKill() {
        pty.eofBlocksUntilExit = true
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 1_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "kill", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.Exit(137), s.exit.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun endStopsWhenTheSignalEndsTheSession() {
        pty.signalled = setOf(42)
        pty.exitsOnSignal = true
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 2_000, signalWaitMs = 2_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        Thread.sleep(300)
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "close"), pty.calls)
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.Exit(129), s.exit.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun endStopsWhenTheEofEndsTheSession() {
        pty.signalled = setOf(42)
        pty.signalledExitAfterMs = 0
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 2_000)
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        Thread.sleep(300)
        assertEquals(listOf("signal", "eof", "close"), pty.calls)
    }

    @Test
    fun inputAndResizeAfterExitAreIgnored() {
        val s = session()
        pty.exit(0)
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        s.write("ls\n".toByteArray())
        s.resize(30, 90)
        assertTrue(pty.written.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(pty.resizes.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun inputAndResizeReachThePtyWhileRunning() {
        val s = session()
        s.write("ls\n".toByteArray())
        s.resize(30, 90)
        assertEquals(listOf("ls\n"), pty.written)
        assertEquals(listOf(30 to 90), pty.resizes)
    }

    @Test
    fun attachReturnsTheScreenItReplaces() {
        val s = session()
        val first = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        val second = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        assertNull(s.attach(first))
        assertSame(first, s.attach(second))
        assertNull(s.attach(second))
        assertTrue(s.hasScreen)
    }

    @Test
    fun detachOnlyRemovesTheAttachedScreen() {
        val s = session()
        val first = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        val second = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        s.attach(first)
        s.attach(second)
        s.detach(first)
        assertTrue(s.hasScreen)
        s.detach(second)
        assertFalse(s.hasScreen)
    }

    @Test
    fun visibilityFollowsTheAttachedScreenOnly() {
        val s = session()
        val first = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        val second = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        assertFalse(s.screenVisible)
        s.attach(first)
        assertTrue(s.screenVisible)
        s.setVisible(first, false)
        assertFalse(s.screenVisible)
        s.attach(second)
        assertTrue(s.screenVisible)
        s.setVisible(first, false)
        assertTrue(s.screenVisible)
        s.detach(second)
        assertFalse(s.screenVisible)
    }

    @Test
    fun throwingOutputStillEndsTheSession() {
        val s = session(sink = { _, _, _ -> throw IllegalStateException("boom") })
        pty.emit("x")
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertTrue(s.exit.value != null)
        assertTrue(pty.closed)
    }

    @Test
    fun endTwiceSendsEofOnce() {
        pty.ignoresEof = true
        val s = session(endGraceMs = 1_000)
        s.end()
        s.end()
        eventually { s.exit.value != null }
        assertEquals(1, pty.eofCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun noInputReachesThePtyOnceItIsClosed() {
        val s = session()
        pty.onClose = {
            s.write("late".toByteArray())
            s.resize(1, 1)
            s.end()
        }
        pty.exit(0)
        eventually { ended.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(0, pty.writesAfterClose)
        assertEquals(0, pty.resizesAfterClose)
        assertEquals(0, pty.eofCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun theDefaultEndTimeoutIsTheEndTimeoutOfTheDefaultSignalWait() {
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.END_TIMEOUT_MS, ManagedSession.endTimeoutMs())
        assertEquals(ManagedSession.END_TIMEOUT_MS, ManagedSession.endTimeoutMs(ManagedSession.SIGNAL_WAIT_MS))
    }

    @Test
    fun theEndTimeoutAddsTheHeadroomToTheWorstCaseOfItsSignalWait() {
        assertEquals(
            ManagedSession.endWorstCaseMs(65_000) + ManagedSession.TIMEOUT_HEADROOM_MS,
            ManagedSession.endTimeoutMs(65_000),
        )
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.LinkOption
import java.nio.file.Paths

class NativeLinksTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private lateinit var prefix: File
    private lateinit var libs: File

    private val symlink: (String, String) -> Unit = { target, link ->
        Files.createSymbolicLink(Paths.get(link), Paths.get(target))
    }

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        prefix = tmp.newFolder("usr")
        libs = tmp.newFolder("lib")
        listOf("libbusybox.so", "libproot.so", "libpr-cli.so").forEach { File(libs, it).writeText("elf") }
    }

    private fun bin(name: String) = File(prefix, "bin/$name")

    private fun target(name: String) = Files.readSymbolicLink(bin(name).toPath()).toString()

    private fun lib(name: String) = File(libs, name).absolutePath

    private fun links(symlink: (String, String) -> Unit = this.symlink) = NativeLinks(prefix, libs, symlink)

    @Test
    fun linksEachNativeLibraryIntoBin() {
        links().ensure()

        assertEquals(lib("libproot.so"), target("proot"))
        assertEquals(lib("libpr-cli.so"), target("pr-cli"))
    }

    @Test
    fun doesNotLinkBusyboxEvenIfTheApkShipsIt() {
        links().ensure()

        assertFalse(Files.exists(bin("busybox").toPath(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
    }

    @Test
    fun skipsALibraryTheApkDoesNotShip() {
        File(libs, "libproot.so").delete()

        links().ensure()

        assertFalse(Files.exists(bin("proot").toPath(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
        assertEquals(lib("libpr-cli.so"), target("pr-cli"))
    }

    @Test
    fun keepsALinkThatAlreadyPointsAtTheLibrary() {
        links().ensure()

        links { _, link -> throw IOException("relinked $link") }.ensure()

        assertEquals(lib("libproot.so"), target("proot"))
    }

    @Test
    fun replacesALinkToAnotherLibraryDirectory() {
        val old = tmp.newFolder("old-lib")
        File(old, "libproot.so").writeText("old")
        bin("proot").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        symlink(File(old, "libproot.so").absolutePath, bin("proot").absolutePath)

        links().ensure()

        assertEquals(lib("libproot.so"), target("proot"))
    }

    @Test
    fun replacesADanglingLink() {
        bin("pr-cli").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        symlink(File(tmp.root, "gone/libpr-cli.so").absolutePath, bin("pr-cli").absolutePath)

        links().ensure()

        assertEquals(lib("libpr-cli.so"), target("pr-cli"))
    }

    @Test
    fun removesStaleBinariesAndTheScriptsDirectory() {
        bin("bash").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        listOf("bash", "pr-test", "proot-distro", "bootstrap.sh").forEach { bin(it).writeText("old") }
        File(prefix, "scripts/proot-distro.sh").apply { parentFile!!.mkdirs() }.writeText("old")

        links().ensure()

        listOf("bash", "pr-test", "proot-distro", "bootstrap.sh").forEach { assertFalse(bin(it).exists()) }
        assertFalse(File(prefix, "scripts").exists())
    }

    @Test
    fun removesTheBusyboxLinkAndEveryAppletLinkToIt() {
        bin("busybox").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        symlink(lib("libbusybox.so"), bin("busybox").absolutePath)
        listOf("sh", "ls", "wget").forEach { symlink("busybox", bin(it).absolutePath) }

        links().ensure()

        listOf("busybox", "sh", "ls", "wget").forEach {
            assertFalse(it, Files.exists(bin(it).toPath(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun removesAppletLinksLeftDanglingByAnEarlierUpgrade() {
        bin("sh").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        symlink("busybox", bin("sh").absolutePath)

        links().ensure()

        assertFalse(Files.exists(bin("sh").toPath(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
    }

    @Test
    fun keepsFilesAndLinksThatAreNotBusybox() {
        bin("mine").parentFile!!.mkdirs()
        bin("mine").writeText("mine")
        symlink("pr-cli", bin("prc").absolutePath)
        symlink(File(tmp.root, "busybox").absolutePath, bin("other").absolutePath)

        links().ensure()

        assertEquals("mine", bin("mine").readText())
        assertEquals("pr-cli", target("prc"))
        assertEquals(File(tmp.root, "busybox").absolutePath, target("other"))
    }
}

    fun failsWhenADirectoryCannotBeCreated() {

        host.prefixDir.mkdirs()
        File(host.prefixDir, "var").writeText("not a directory")

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import id.or.oo.pr.engine.ProotHost
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

class PrCliCommandTest {

    private val host = object : ProotHost {
        override val prefixDir = File("/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr")
        override val homeDir = File("/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/home")
        override val packageName = "org.example.gateway"
        override val cacheDir = File("/data/data/org.example.gateway/cache")
        override val dnsServers = listOf("192.0.2.53", "2001:db8::53")
    }

    private class FakeRunner(private val lines: List<String>, private val exitCode: Int) : CommandRunner {
        var cmd: List<String>? = null
        var env: Map<String, String>? = null

        override suspend fun run(cmd: List<String>, env: Map<String, String>, onLine: (String) -> Unit): Int {
            this.cmd = cmd
            this.env = env
            lines.forEach(onLine)
            return exitCode
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun runsPrCliFromTheHostPrefixWithTheHostEnvironment() = runBlocking {
        val runner = FakeRunner(emptyList(), 0)

        PrCliCommand(host, runner).run(listOf("install", "alpine")) { }

        assertEquals(listOf("/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr/bin/pr-cli", "install", "alpine"), runner.cmd)
        assertEquals(
            mapOf(
                "APP_PREFIX" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr",
                "APP_HOME" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/home",
                "APP_PACKAGE" to "org.example.gateway",
                "PATH" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/usr/bin:/system/bin:/system/xbin",
                "PROOT_NO_SECCOMP" to "1",
                "PROOT_TMP_DIR" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/cache",
                "HOME" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/files/home",
                "TERM" to "xterm-256color",
                "TMPDIR" to "/data/data/org.example.gateway/cache",
                "APP_DNS_SERVERS" to "192.0.2.53,2001:db8::53",
            ),
            runner.env,
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun stripsEscapesAndCarriageReturnsAndDropsBlankLines() = runBlocking {
        val runner = FakeRunner(
            listOf("\u001B[1;32mInstalled\u001B[0m\r", "   ", "\u001B]0;pr-cli\u0007Done", ""),
            0,
        )
        val seen = mutableListOf<String>()

        PrCliCommand(host, runner).run(listOf("install", "alpine")) { seen += it }

        assertEquals(listOf("Installed", "Done"), seen)
    }

    @Test
    fun returnsTheRunnerExitCode() = runBlocking {
        assertEquals(3, PrCliCommand(host, FakeRunner(emptyList(), 3)).run(listOf("remove", "alpine")) { })
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class ProcStatTest {

    @Test
    fun readsTheParentPidAfterTheCommandName() {
        assertEquals(1794, parentPid("1804 (sh) S 1794 1804 1794 34816 1804 4194560 900"))
    }

    @Test
    fun handlesSpacesAndParenthesesInTheCommandName() {
        assertEquals(7, parentPid("42 (a (b) c) R 7 42 42 0 -1 4194304"))
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsAMalformedLine() {
        assertNull(parentPid("garbage"))
    }

    private fun status(pid: Int, tracer: Int) =
        "Name:\tsh\nState:\tS (sleeping)\nTgid:\t$pid\nPid:\t$pid\nPPid:\t1\nTracerPid:\t$tracer\nUid:\t10200\n"

    @Test
    fun readsTheTracerPidFromStatus() {
        assertEquals(1790, tracerPid(status(1804, 1790)))
    }

    @Test
    fun aStatusWithoutTracerPidHasNone() {
        assertNull(tracerPid("Name:\tsh\nPid:\t1804\n"))
    }

    @Test
    fun traceesAreTheProcessesTracedByProotExceptTheExcludedOnes() {
        val statuses = mapOf(
            1790 to status(1790, 0),
            1804 to status(1804, 1790),
            1810 to status(1810, 1804),
            1811 to status(1811, 1790),
            1900 to status(1900, 1790),
            2000 to status(2000, 0),
            2100 to status(2100, 3000),
        )
        assertEquals(setOf(1811, 1900), traceesOf(1790, statuses, exclude = setOf(1790, 1804)))
    }

    @Test
    fun traceesAreUnknownWhenAStatusCannotBeRead() {
        assertNull(traceesOf(1790, mapOf(1804 to status(1804, 1790), 1900 to null), exclude = setOf(1804)))
    }

    @Test
    fun traceesAreUnknownWhenAStatusHasNoTracerPid() {
        assertNull(traceesOf(1790, mapOf(1900 to "Name:\tsh\nPid:\t1900\n"), exclude = emptySet()))
    }

    @Test
    fun readsTheProcessState() {
        assertEquals('Z', processState("1900 (a (b) c) Z 1 1900 1900 0 -1 4194304"))
        assertEquals('S', processState("1804 (sh) S 1794 1804 1794 34816 1804 4194560 900"))
        assertNull(processState("garbage"))
    }

    @Test
    fun forceKillTargetsEveryTraceeIncludingTheLoginShellBeforeProot() {
        val statuses = mapOf(
            1790 to status(1790, 0),
            1804 to status(1804, 1790),
            1811 to status(1811, 1790),
            1900 to status(1900, 1790),
            2000 to status(2000, 0),
            2100 to status(2100, 3000),
        )
        assertEquals(listOf(1804, 1811, 1900, 1790), forceKillTargets(1790, statuses) { listOf(5000) })
    }

    @Test
    fun forceKillFallsBackToTheWalkWhenTraceesAreUnknown() {
        val statuses = mapOf(1804 to status(1804, 1790), 1900 to null)
        assertEquals(listOf(1804, 1900, 1790), forceKillTargets(1790, statuses) { listOf(1804, 1790, 1900) })
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/test/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ProcessRunnerTest.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

class ProcessRunnerTest {

    private val lines = CopyOnWriteArrayList<String>()

    private fun alive(pid: Int) = SystemProcFs.stat(pid)?.let(::processState).let { it != null && it != 'Z' && it != 'X' }

    private fun sh(script: String) = listOf("/bin/sh", "-c", script)

    private val myPid by lazy { File("/proc/self").canonicalFile.name.toInt() }

    @Before
    fun needsProc() {
        assumeTrue(File("/proc/self").exists())
    }

    private fun runner(stopWaitMs: Long = ProcessRunner.STOP_WAIT_MS) =
        ProcessRunner(myPid, { pid, signal -> ProcessBuilder("kill", "-$signal", "$pid").start().waitFor() }, stopWaitMs = stopWaitMs)

    private fun cancelAfterTwoLines(runner: ProcessRunner, script: String): Pair<List<Int>, Long> = runBlocking {
        var returned: Int? = null
        val job = launch(Dispatchers.Default) { returned = runner.run(sh(script), emptyMap()) { lines += it } }
        withTimeout(10_000) { while (lines.size < 2) delay(10) }
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        withTimeout(10_000) { job.cancelAndJoin() }
        assertTrue(job.isCancelled)
        assertNull(returned)
        lines.map { it.toInt() } to (System.nanoTime() - started) / 1_000_000
    }

    @Test
    fun linesStreamInOrderAndTheExitCodeIsReturned() = runBlocking {
        val code = withTimeout(10_000) {
            runner().run(sh("echo one; echo two >&2; exit 3"), emptyMap()) { lines += it }
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("one", "two"), lines)
        assertEquals(3, code)
    }

    @Test
    fun theEnvironmentIsPassed() = runBlocking {
        withTimeout(10_000) {
            runner().run(sh("echo \"\$PR_TEST_VALUE\""), mapOf("PR_TEST_VALUE" to "set")) { lines += it }
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("set"), lines)
    }

    @Test
    fun standardInputIsClosedSoAReaderOfItDoesNotBlock() = runBlocking {
        val code = withTimeout(10_000) {
            runner().run(sh("cat; echo done"), emptyMap()) { lines += it }
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("done"), lines)
        assertEquals(0, code)
    }

    @Test
    fun aFailingReadStopsTheProcessBeforeRethrowing() = runBlocking {
        var pid = 0
        val failure = runCatching {
            withTimeout(10_000) {
                runner(stopWaitMs = 500).run(sh("echo \$\$; exec sleep 30"), emptyMap()) {
                    pid = it.toInt()
                    throw IllegalStateException("boom")
                }
            }
        }.exceptionOrNull()
        assertEquals("boom", failure?.message)
        assertTrue(pid > 0)
        assertFalse(alive(pid))
    }

    @Test
    fun cancellingStopsTheProcessAndItsDescendants() {
        val (pids, tookMs) = cancelAfterTwoLines(runner(), "sleep 30 & echo \$!; echo \$\$; wait")
        assertTrue(pids.none(::alive))
        assertTrue("took $tookMs ms", tookMs < ProcessRunner.STOP_WAIT_MS)
    }

    @Test
    fun aTreeThatIgnoresTermIsKilledAfterTheWait() {
        val (pids, tookMs) = cancelAfterTwoLines(runner(stopWaitMs = 300), "trap '' TERM; sleep 30 & echo \$!; echo \$\$; wait")
        assertTrue(pids.none(::alive))
        assertTrue("took $tookMs ms", tookMs >= 300)
    }

    @Test
    fun anExitCodeKnownWhenCancellationArrivesIsReturned() = runBlocking {
        var result: Int? = null
        val job = launch { result = runner().run(sh("echo started; sleep 0.3; exit 7"), emptyMap()) { lines += it } }
        withTimeout(10_000) { while (lines.isEmpty()) delay(5) }
        delay(20)
        Thread.sleep(1_000)

        job.cancel()
        job.join()

        assertEquals(7, result)
    }

    @Test
    fun anExitThatHappenedBeforeTheCancelIsReturnedWhileADescendantHoldsTheOutput() = runBlocking {
        var result: Int? = null
        val job = launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
            result = runner().run(sh("(sleep 1.5; echo late) & echo \$\$; exit 0"), emptyMap()) { lines += it }
        }
        withTimeout(10_000) { while (lines.isEmpty()) delay(5) }
        val shell = lines.first().toInt()
        withTimeout(10_000) { while (SystemProcFs.stat(shell) != null) delay(5) }

        withTimeout(10_000) { job.cancelAndJoin() }

        assertEquals(0, result)
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ProotProcessesTest {

    private val app = 1700
    private val proot = 1790
    private val shell = 1804

    private fun session(childrenFiles: Boolean = false) = FakeProcFs(childrenFiles).apply {
        add(app, ppid = 1)
        add(proot, ppid = app)
        add(shell, ppid = proot, tracer = proot)
        add(1810, ppid = shell, tracer = proot)
        add(1811, ppid = 1810, tracer = proot)
    }

    @Test
    fun endTargetsAreProotsTraceesExceptTheLoginShellAndProot() {
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811), ProotProcesses(session()).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun endTargetsFindTheLoginShellThroughChildrenFilesWhenTheKernelHasThem() {
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811), ProotProcesses(session(childrenFiles = true)).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun anotherProotsTraceesAreUntouched() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(2790, ppid = app)
            add(2804, ppid = 2790, tracer = 2790)
            add(2810, ppid = 2804, tracer = 2790)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun aDaemonReparentedToInitIsStillFoundByItsTracer() {
        val proc = session().apply { add(1900, ppid = 1, tracer = proot) }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811, 1900), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun endTargetsFallBackToTheShellsDescendantsWhenAStatusCannotBeRead() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, statusReadable = false)
            add(1900, ppid = 1, tracer = proot)
            add(2790, ppid = app)
            add(2804, ppid = 2790, tracer = 2790)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811, 1820), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun aStatusUnreadableWhileTheProcessStillExistsForcesTheWalk() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, statusReadable = false, statReadable = false)
            add(1900, ppid = 1, tracer = proot)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun theFallbackWalkReadsTheChildrenFilesOfEveryTask() {
        val proc = session(childrenFiles = true).apply {
            add(1810, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, threads = listOf(1812), statusReadable = false)
            add(1830, ppid = 1810, tracer = proot, forkedBy = 1812)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811, 1830), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun aPidVanishingBetweenTheStatusListingAndItsReadIsSkippedWithoutFallingBack() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot)
            add(1900, ppid = 1, tracer = proot)
            vanishAfterListing(1820, listing = 2)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811, 1900), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
        assertEquals(listOf("status 1820", "exists 1820"), proc.readsAfterVanishing)
    }

    @Test
    fun aPidVanishingDuringTheFallbackWalkIsSkipped() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, statusReadable = false)
            add(1821, ppid = shell, tracer = proot)
            vanishAfterListing(1821, listing = 3)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811, 1820), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot))
        assertEquals(listOf("stat 1821"), proc.readsAfterVanishing)
    }

    @Test
    fun theShellsAreProotsChildren() {
        assertEquals(listOf(shell), ProotProcesses(session()).shells(proot))
        assertEquals(listOf(shell), ProotProcesses(session(childrenFiles = true)).shells(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun zombieDeadAndMissingProcessesCountAsExited() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1900, ppid = shell, state = 'Z')
            add(1901, ppid = shell, state = 'X')
        }
        val processes = ProotProcesses(proc)
        assertFalse(processes.alive(setOf(1900, 1901, 4242)))
        assertTrue(processes.alive(setOf(1900, 1810)))
    }

    @Test
    fun aChildIsFoundByItsExactCommandLine() {
        val prCli = "/data/user/0/id.or.oo.pr/files/usr/bin/pr-cli"
        val test = listOf(prCli, "test", "alpine")
        listOf(false, true).forEach { childrenFiles ->
            val proc = session(childrenFiles).apply {
                add(2000, ppid = app, cmdline = test)
                add(2001, ppid = app, cmdline = listOf(prCli, "login", "alpine", "--user", "root"))
                add(2002, ppid = app, cmdline = listOf(prCli, "test", "alpine", "extra"))
                add(2003, ppid = app, state = 'Z', cmdline = test)
                add(2004, ppid = 2000, cmdline = test)
            }
            assertEquals(listOf(2000), ProotProcesses(proc).children(app, test))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun descendantsAreEveryProcessBelowTheRoots() {
        listOf(false, true).forEach { childrenFiles ->
            val proc = session(childrenFiles).apply {
                add(2000, ppid = app)
                add(2010, ppid = 2000)
                add(2011, ppid = 2010)
                add(2012, ppid = 2000)
            }
            assertEquals(setOf(2010, 2011, 2012), ProotProcesses(proc).descendants(listOf(2000)).toSet())
            assertEquals(emptyList<Int>(), ProotProcesses(proc).descendants(emptyList()))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun forceKillTargetsEveryTraceeIncludingTheLoginShellEndingWithProot() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1900, ppid = 1, tracer = proot)
            add(2790, ppid = app)
            add(2804, ppid = 2790, tracer = 2790)
        }
        assertEquals(listOf(shell, 1810, 1811, 1900, proot), ProotProcesses(proc).forceKillTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun forceKillFallsBackToProotsDescendantsEndingWithProot() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, statusReadable = false)
            add(2790, ppid = app)
            add(2804, ppid = 2790, tracer = 2790)
        }
        assertEquals(listOf(shell, 1810, 1820, 1811, proot), ProotProcesses(proc).forceKillTargets(proot))
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandThatIsProotsDirectChildIsAnEndTargetForACommandSession() {
        listOf(false, true).forEach { childrenFiles ->
            val proc = FakeProcFs(childrenFiles).apply {
                add(app, ppid = 1)
                add(proot, ppid = app)
                add(shell, ppid = proot, tracer = proot, cmdline = listOf("httpd", "-f", "-p", "8080"))
            }
            assertEquals(setOf(shell), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot, EndPolicy.SIGNAL_EVERY_TRACEE))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aShellThatStayedAndItsCommandsAreAllEndTargetsForACommandSession() {
        listOf(false, true).forEach { childrenFiles ->
            assertEquals(
                setOf(shell, 1810, 1811),
                ProotProcesses(session(childrenFiles)).endTargets(proot, EndPolicy.SIGNAL_EVERY_TRACEE),
            )
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun aCommandSessionsFallbackWalkIncludesProotsChildren() {
        val proc = session().apply {
            add(1820, ppid = shell, tracer = proot, statusReadable = false)
            add(2790, ppid = app)
            add(2804, ppid = 2790, tracer = 2790)
        }
        assertEquals(setOf(shell, 1810, 1811, 1820), ProotProcesses(proc).endTargets(proot, EndPolicy.SIGNAL_EVERY_TRACEE))
    }

    @Test
    fun aTerminalSessionStillSparesTheLoginShell() {
        assertEquals(setOf(1810, 1811), ProotProcesses(session()).endTargets(proot, EndPolicy.SPARE_LOGIN_SHELL))
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.content.Intent
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

class ServiceForegroundControllerTest {

    private val undeclared = object : ContextWrapper(null) {
        override fun startForegroundService(service: Intent?): ComponentName? = null
    }

    private val ptys = CopyOnWriteArrayList<FakePty>()

    private val sessions = SessionManager(
        { alias, onEnded ->
            val pty = FakePty().also { ptys += it }
            ManagedSession(alias, pty, null, { _, _, _ -> }, onEnded, exitCodeWaitMs = 100)
        },
        ServiceForegroundController(undeclared),
    ) { _, _ -> }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        ptys.forEach { it.exit(0) }
    }

    @Test
    fun anUndeclaredServiceIsReportedAsTheBackgroundErrorAndTheSessionStillOpens() {
        val result = sessions.open("debian")

        assertTrue(result is SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened)
        assertEquals(listOf("debian"), sessions.running.value)
        assertEquals("SessionService is not declared in the app manifest", sessions.backgroundError.value)
    }
}

FILE: ./pr-source/android/session-core/src/test/java/id/or/oo/pr/session/ServiceStateTest.kt
----------------------------------------------------------------------
package id.or.oo.pr.session

import id.or.oo.pr.session.ServiceState.Action.Notify
import id.or.oo.pr.session.ServiceState.Action.StartForeground
import id.or.oo.pr.session.ServiceState.Action.Stop
import id.or.oo.pr.session.ServiceState.Action.WakeLock
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ServiceStateTest {

    private val state = ServiceState()

    @Test
    fun aStartWithNoSessionStartsForegroundThenStopsWithItsId() {
        assertEquals(
            listOf(StartForeground(emptyList(), false), Stop(1)),
            state.onStartCommand(1, emptyList(), false),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun aStartWithASessionStartsForegroundAndKeepsRunning() {
        assertEquals(listOf(StartForeground(listOf("a"), true)), state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), true))
    }

    @Test
    fun nothingStopsBeforeTheFirstStartForeground() {
        val actions = state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false)
        assertFalse(actions.any { it is Stop })
    }

    @Test
    fun aRunningSessionIsNotifiedEvenBeforeTheFirstStart() {
        assertTrue(Notify(listOf("a"), false) in state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), false))
    }

    @Test
    fun theRunningListEmptyingStopsWithTheLastStartId() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        state.onStartCommand(2, listOf("a"), false)
        val actions = state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false)
        assertEquals(listOf(Stop(2)), actions.filterIsInstance<Stop>())
        assertFalse(actions.any { it is Notify })
    }

    @Test
    fun anEmptyListAfterAStopDoesNotStopAgain() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false)
        assertFalse(state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false).any { it is Stop })
    }

    @Test
    fun aStartArrivingWhileStoppingKeepsTheServiceAndLaterStopsUseTheNewerId() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        assertEquals(listOf(Stop(1)), state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false).filterIsInstance<Stop>())
        assertEquals(listOf(StartForeground(listOf("b"), false)), state.onStartCommand(2, listOf("b"), false))
        assertEquals(listOf(Notify(listOf("b"), false)), state.onRunningChanged(listOf("b"), false).filter { it !is WakeLock })
        assertEquals(listOf(Stop(2)), state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false).filterIsInstance<Stop>())
    }

    @Test
    fun aStartWithNoSessionAfterAStopStopsWithTheNewerId() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false)
        assertEquals(
            listOf(StartForeground(emptyList(), false), Stop(2)),
            state.onStartCommand(2, emptyList(), false),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun aConflatedEmptyListKeepsTheService() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), false)
        assertEquals(listOf(StartForeground(listOf("a"), false)), state.onStartCommand(2, listOf("a"), false))
        val actions = state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), false)
        assertFalse(actions.any { it is Stop })
        assertTrue(Notify(listOf("a"), false) in actions)
    }

    @Test
    fun theWakeLockFollowsKeepAwakeWhileASessionRuns() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), false)
        assertEquals(WakeLock(false), state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), false).filterIsInstance<WakeLock>().single())
        assertEquals(WakeLock(true), state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), true).filterIsInstance<WakeLock>().single())
        assertEquals(WakeLock(false), state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), true).filterIsInstance<WakeLock>().single())
    }

    @Test
    fun theWakeLockIsReleasedBeforeTheStop() {
        state.onStartCommand(1, listOf("a"), true)
        state.onRunningChanged(listOf("a"), true)
        assertEquals(listOf(WakeLock(false), Stop(1)), state.onRunningChanged(emptyList(), false))
    }
}

package id.or.oo.pr.session

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlin.concurrent.thread

class SessionManagerTest {

    private val ptys = ConcurrentHashMap<String, FakePty>()
    private val created = AtomicInteger()
    private val foregroundCalls = CopyOnWriteArrayList<String>()
    private val endedNotices = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Pair<String, Int?>>()
    private var failNext = false
    private var foregroundFails = false
    private val runningAtStart = CopyOnWriteArrayList<List<String>>()
    @Volatile private var beforeEnded: (ManagedSession) -> Unit = {}
    @Volatile private var endGraceMs = 100L

    private val factory = SessionManager.SessionFactory { alias, onEnded ->
        if (failNext) throw IllegalStateException("pr-cli not found")
        created.incrementAndGet()
        val pty = FakePty()
        ptys[alias] = pty
        ManagedSession(
            alias,
            pty,
            null,
            { _, _, _ -> },
            { session -> beforeEnded(session); onEnded(session) },
            endGraceMs = endGraceMs,
            exitCodeWaitMs = 100,
        )
    }

    private val foreground: SessionManager.ForegroundController = object : SessionManager.ForegroundController {
        override fun start() {
            if (foregroundFails) throw IllegalStateException("not allowed")
            runningAtStart += manager.running.value
            foregroundCalls += "start"
        }
    }

    private val manager = SessionManager(factory, foreground) { alias, code -> endedNotices += alias to code }

    private fun open(alias: String) =
        (manager.open(alias) as SessionManager.OpenResult.Opened).session

    @Test
    fun settingKeepCpuAwakeWithNoSessionsLeavesItOff() {
        manager.setKeepCpuAwake(true)
        assertEquals(false, manager.keepCpuAwake.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun settingKeepCpuAwakeWhileRunningSetsIt() {
        open("alpine")
        manager.setKeepCpuAwake(true)
        assertEquals(true, manager.keepCpuAwake.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun openingARunningContainerReturnsTheSameSession() {
        val first = open("alpine")
        val second = open("alpine")
        assertSame(first, second)
        assertEquals(1, created.get())
        assertEquals(listOf("alpine"), manager.running.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun openingAnEndingSessionWaitsThenStartsAFreshOne() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        ptys.getValue("alpine").ignoresEof = true
        manager.end("alpine")
        assertEquals(SessionManager.OpenResult.Ending(session), manager.open("alpine"))
        eventually { session.exit.value != null }
        assertNotSame(session, open("alpine"))
        assertEquals(2, created.get())
    }

    @Test
    fun foregroundStartsWithTheFirstSessionOnly() {
        open("alpine")
        open("ubuntu")
        assertEquals(listOf("alpine", "ubuntu"), manager.running.value)
        assertEquals(listOf("start"), foregroundCalls)
        manager.end("alpine")
        eventually { manager.running.value == listOf("ubuntu") }
        ptys.getValue("ubuntu").exit(0)
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("start"), foregroundCalls)
    }

    @Test
    fun keepCpuAwakeResetsWhenTheLastSessionEnds() {
        open("alpine")
        manager.setKeepCpuAwake(true)
        manager.endAll()
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        assertEquals(false, manager.keepCpuAwake.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun programExitWithNoScreenPostsTheEndedNotice() {
        open("alpine")
        ptys.getValue("alpine").exit(1)
        eventually { endedNotices.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("alpine" to 1), endedNotices)
    }

    @Test
    fun endingASessionPostsNoEndedNotice() {
        open("alpine")
        manager.end("alpine")
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        Thread.sleep(50)
        assertTrue(endedNotices.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun anEndedSessionStaysWhileAScreenShowsIt() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        ptys.getValue("alpine").exit(2)
        eventually { session.exit.value != null }
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        assertTrue(endedNotices.isEmpty())
        manager.detach(session, screen)
        val next = open("alpine")
        assertNotSame(session, next)
        assertEquals(2, created.get())
    }

    @Test
    fun programExitWhileTheScreenIsHiddenPostsTheNotice() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        manager.setVisible(session, screen, false)
        ptys.getValue("alpine").exit(3)
        eventually { endedNotices.isNotEmpty() }
        assertEquals(listOf("alpine" to 3), endedNotices)
        assertTrue(session.hasScreen)
    }

    @Test
    fun aScreenShownAgainBeforeTheExitPostsNoNotice() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        manager.setVisible(session, screen, false)
        manager.setVisible(session, screen, true)
        ptys.getValue("alpine").exit(3)
        eventually { session.exit.value != null }
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        Thread.sleep(50)
        assertTrue(endedNotices.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun endingWhileTheScreenIsHiddenPostsNoNotice() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        manager.setVisible(session, screen, false)
        manager.end("alpine")
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        Thread.sleep(50)
        assertTrue(endedNotices.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun aRecreatedScreenGetsTheEndedSessionBack() {
        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        ptys.getValue("alpine").exit(2)
        eventually { session.exit.value != null }
        eventually { manager.running.value.isEmpty() }
        manager.detach(session, screen, retainEnded = true)
        assertSame(session, open("alpine"))
        val recreated = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, recreated)
        manager.detach(session, recreated)
        assertNotSame(session, open("alpine"))
        assertEquals(2, created.get())
    }

        assertSame(session, open("alpine"))

        manager.attach(session, recreated)

        val session = open("alpine")
        val screen = ManagedSession.Screen {}
        manager.attach(session, screen)
        manager.detach(session, screen, retainEnded = true)

        manager.attach(session, screen)
